source.text: וַיִּקַּ֨ח שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל אֶת־פַּ֥ךְ הַשֶּׁ֛מֶן וַיִּצֹ֥ק עַל־רֹאשׁ֖וֹ וַיִּשָּׁקֵ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הֲל֗וֹא כִּֽי־מְשָׁחֲךָ֧ יְהוָ֛ה עַל־נַחֲלָת֖וֹ לְנָגִֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Samuel [the] flask of the oil and poured [it] on his head, and kissed him, and said, [is it] not that has anointed you Yahweh over his inheritance as ruler?

en.L: And Samuel took the flask of oil and poured [it] on his head, and kissed him, and said, "Is it not that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has anointed you over {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} inheritance as ruler?
en.B: Then Samuel took the flask of oil and poured it on Saul's head. He kissed him and said, "Has not {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} anointed you to be ruler over {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own inheritance?
en.R: Then Samuel took a small jar of olive oil and poured it on Saul's head. He kissed Saul and said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has anointed you to be the leader of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, who belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y Samuel tomó el frasco del aceite y [lo] derramó sobre su cabeza, y lo besó, y dijo: «¿No es que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te ha ungido como gobernante sobre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} heredad?
es.B: Entonces Samuel tomó el frasco de aceite y lo derramó sobre la cabeza de Saúl. Lo besó y le dijo: «¿No te ha ungido {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} para que seas gobernante de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia heredad?
es.R: Entonces Samuel tomó una pequeña jarra de aceite de oliva y la derramó sobre la cabeza de Saúl. Lo besó y le dijo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te ha ungido para que seas el líder de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, el pueblo que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenece.

fr.L: Et Samuel prit la fiole d’huile et [la] versa sur sa tête, et il l’embrassa et dit : « N’est-ce pas que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a oint comme chef sur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} héritage ?
fr.B: Alors Samuel prit la fiole d’huile et la versa sur la tête de Saül. Il l’embrassa et dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne t’a-t-il pas oint pour que tu sois le chef de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre héritage ?
fr.R: Alors Samuel a pris une petite fiole d’huile d’olive et l’a versée sur la tête de Saül. Il a embrassé Saül et lui a dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a oint pour que tu sois le chef de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, le peuple qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartient.

sw.L: Na Samweli akachukua chupa ya mafuta akayamimina juu ya kichwa chake, akambusu, akasema, "Je, si kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekupaka mafuta juu ya urithi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} uwe kiongozi?
sw.B: Kisha Samweli akachukua chupa ya mafuta akayamimina juu ya kichwa cha Sauli. Akambusu, akasema, "Je, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakukupaka mafuta uwe kiongozi juu ya urithi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe?
sw.R: Kisha Samweli akachukua chupa ndogo ya mafuta ya zeituni akayamimina juu ya kichwa cha Sauli. Akambusu Sauli, akasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekupaka mafuta uwe kiongozi wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, walio mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên lấy bình dầu đổ trên đầu Sau-lơ, hôn ông và nói: "Chẳng phải {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xức dầu cho ông làm người lãnh đạo cơ nghiệp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sao?
vi.B: Bấy giờ Sa-mu-ên lấy bình dầu đổ trên đầu Sau-lơ, hôn ông và nói: "Chẳng phải {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xức dầu cho ông làm người lãnh đạo cơ nghiệp của chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sao?
vi.R: Bấy giờ Sa-mu-ên lấy một bình nhỏ dầu ô-liu đổ trên đầu Sau-lơ. Người hôn Sau-lơ và nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xức dầu cho ông làm người lãnh đạo dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là dân thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: the Hebrew text: Samuel asks one question, "Is it not that the LORD has anointed you over his inheritance as ruler?"
alternatives: the longer Greek text, adding "You will rule over the people of the LORD and save them from their enemies all around, and this will be the sign for you"
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation has a longer text here, roughly: "Has not the LORD anointed you ruler over his people Israel? You will rule over the people of the LORD and save them from the hand of their enemies all around. And this will be the sign for you that the LORD has anointed you ruler over his inheritance:" and then the signs of verses 2-7 follow. The Hebrew "Is it not that ..." reads a little abruptly, and the Greek wording repeats "anointed you ruler over", so a copyist's eye may have jumped from the first to the second and dropped the words between. The Hebrew text is followed here. This description comes from general knowledge of the Greek manuscripts and must be checked against an edition of the Greek text before review.

decisions.choice: pouring oil on the head: anointing, the act that set a person apart for an office
decisions.reason: Priests were anointed with oil (Exodus 29:7), and now a king is. The oil marks Saul as chosen by the LORD (9:16), which is why a king is later called "the LORD's anointed" (12:3; 24:7). The kiss is a sign of respect and goodwill toward him.

decisions.choice: ruler: the one designated to lead
decisions.reason: The word is not the ordinary word for king. It names a leader chosen and appointed from above, as in 9:16 and 13:14. Samuel uses it before Saul is publicly made king (verses 24-25).

decisions.choice: his inheritance: Israel, the people who belong to the LORD
decisions.reason: Israel is called the LORD's inheritance, the share that is his own (Deuteronomy 9:26, 29; 32:9). Saul is to rule a people that belongs to God, not to himself.

decisions.choice: a statement in place of the question (Readable)
decisions.reason: The question "Has not the LORD anointed you?" expects the answer yes. Readable says it as a plain statement and spells out "his inheritance" as "his people, who belong to him" (m4).

decisions.choice: Saul's head
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Saul, since a new chapter begins here.

decisions.choice: Samuel still calls Saul "ông" after anointing him, and the narrator now calls Saul "ông"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: Samuel and Saul say "ông" to each other at first. From his anointing the narrator speaks of Saul with the respect due to a chosen leader.

decisions.choice: "cơ nghiệp của Ngài" (L, B); "dân thuộc về Ngài" (R)
decisions.reason: Israel, the people who belong to the LORD (meaning decision); "cơ nghiệp" is the Bible word for an inheritance, and Readable says it plainly.

source.text: בְּלֶכְתְּךָ֤ הַיּוֹם֙ מֵעִמָּדִ֔י וּמָצָאתָ֩ שְׁנֵ֨י אֲנָשִׁ֜ים עִם־קְבֻרַ֥ת רָחֵ֛ל בִּגְב֥וּל בִּנְיָמִ֖ן בְּצֶלְצַ֑ח וְאָמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֗יךָ נִמְצְא֤וּ הָאֲתֹנוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַ֣כְתָּ לְבַקֵּ֔שׁ וְהִנֵּ֨ה נָטַ֤שׁ אָבִ֨יךָ֙ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֣י הָאֲתֹנ֔וֹת וְדָאַ֤ג לָכֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מָ֥ה אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה לִבְנִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: When you go today from with me, and you will find two men by [the] tomb of Rachel in [the] territory of Benjamin at Zelzah, and they will say to you, have been found the she-donkeys which you went to seek, and look, has left your father the matters of the she-donkeys and is anxious for you, saying, what shall I do for my son?

en.L: When you go from me today, you will find two men by the tomb of Rachel in the territory of Benjamin at Zelzah, and they will say to you, 'The donkeys that you went to look for have been found, and look, your father has left off the matter of the donkeys and is anxious about you, saying, "What shall I do about my son?"'
en.B: When you leave me today, you will come upon two men near Rachel's tomb at Zelzah, in the territory of Benjamin. They will tell you, 'The donkeys you went looking for have been found. Your father has stopped thinking about the donkeys and is worried about you. He is saying, "What am I to do about my son?"'
en.R: Today, after you leave me, you will meet two men near the place where Rachel is buried, at Zelzah in the land of Benjamin. They will say to you, 'The donkeys you were looking for have been found. Now your father is not worried about the donkeys anymore. He is worried about you instead. He keeps asking, "What can I do about my son?"'

es.L: Cuando te vayas hoy de mi lado, hallarás a dos hombres junto al sepulcro de Raquel, en el territorio de Benjamín, en Selsa, y te dirán: “Han sido halladas las asnas que fuiste a buscar, y he aquí, tu padre ha dejado el asunto de las asnas y está preocupado por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, diciendo: ‘¿Qué haré por mi hijo?’”.
es.B: Cuando te separes hoy de mí, te encontrarás con dos hombres cerca de la tumba de Raquel, en Selsa, en el territorio de Benjamín. Ellos te dirán: “Ya encontraron las burras que fuiste a buscar. Tu padre ha dejado de pensar en las burras y está preocupado por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Anda diciendo: ‘¿Qué voy a hacer por mi hijo?’”.
es.R: Hoy, cuando te vayas de aquí, te encontrarás con dos hombres cerca del lugar donde está enterrada Raquel, en Selsa, en la tierra de Benjamín. Ellos te dirán: “Ya encontraron las burras que estabas buscando. Ahora tu padre ya no está preocupado por las burras. Ahora está preocupado por ti. No deja de preguntar: ‘¿Qué puedo hacer por mi hijo?’”.

fr.L: Quand tu t’en iras aujourd’hui d’auprès de moi, tu trouveras deux hommes près du tombeau de Rachel, sur le territoire de Benjamin, à Tseltsah, et ils te diront : “Les ânesses que tu es allé chercher ont été retrouvées, et voici, ton père a laissé l’affaire des ânesses et s’inquiète pour vous, en disant : ‘Que ferai-je pour mon fils ?’”
fr.B: Quand tu m’auras quitté aujourd’hui, tu rencontreras deux hommes près du tombeau de Rachel, à Tseltsah, sur le territoire de Benjamin. Ils te diront : “Les ânesses que tu es allé chercher ont été retrouvées. Ton père ne pense plus aux ânesses, il s’inquiète pour vous. Il dit : ‘Que dois-je faire pour mon fils ?’”
fr.R: Aujourd’hui, après m’avoir quitté, tu rencontreras deux hommes près de l’endroit où Rachel est enterrée, à Tseltsah, dans le pays de Benjamin. Ils te diront : “On a retrouvé les ânesses que tu cherchais. Maintenant, ton père ne s’inquiète plus pour les ânesses. C’est pour toi qu’il s’inquiète. Il n’arrête pas de demander : ‘Qu’est-ce que je peux faire pour mon fils ?’”

sw.L: Utakapoondoka kwangu leo, utawakuta watu wawili karibu na kaburi la Raheli katika mpaka wa Benyamini huko Selsa, nao watakuambia, 'Punda uliokwenda kuwatafuta wamepatikana, na tazama, baba yako ameacha habari ya punda na anakuhangaikia, akisema, "Nifanye nini kwa ajili ya mwanangu?"'
sw.B: Utakaponiacha leo, utakutana na watu wawili karibu na kaburi la Raheli huko Selsa, katika nchi ya Benyamini. Watakuambia, 'Punda uliokwenda kuwatafuta wamepatikana. Baba yako ameacha kuwafikiria punda, na sasa ana wasiwasi juu yako. Anasema, "Nifanye nini kuhusu mwanangu?"'
sw.R: Leo, baada ya kuniacha, utakutana na watu wawili karibu na mahali alipozikwa Raheli, huko Selsa katika nchi ya Benyamini. Watakuambia, 'Punda uliokuwa ukiwatafuta wamepatikana. Sasa baba yako hana wasiwasi tena kuhusu punda. Badala yake ana wasiwasi juu yako. Anaendelea kuuliza, "Nifanye nini kuhusu mwanangu?"'

vi.L: Hôm nay khi ông rời khỏi tôi, ông sẽ gặp hai người gần mộ Ra-chên trong lãnh thổ Bên-gia-min, tại Xên-xa, và họ sẽ nói với ông: 'Những con lừa cái mà ông đi tìm đã được tìm thấy rồi; kìa, cha ông đã thôi lo chuyện lừa mà lo lắng cho các ông, và nói: "Tôi phải làm gì cho con trai tôi đây?"'
vi.B: Hôm nay khi rời khỏi tôi, ông sẽ gặp hai người gần mộ Ra-chên tại Xên-xa, thuộc lãnh thổ Bên-gia-min. Họ sẽ nói với ông: 'Đàn lừa ông đi tìm đã được tìm thấy rồi. Cha ông không còn nghĩ đến đàn lừa nữa mà đang lo cho các ông. Ông ấy nói: "Tôi phải làm gì cho con trai tôi đây?"'
vi.R: Hôm nay, sau khi rời khỏi tôi, ông sẽ gặp hai người gần nơi chôn cất Ra-chên, tại Xên-xa trong đất Bên-gia-min. Họ sẽ nói với ông: 'Đàn lừa ông đi tìm đã được tìm thấy rồi. Bây giờ cha ông không còn lo về đàn lừa nữa. Ông ấy lại lo cho ông. Ông ấy cứ hỏi: "Tôi phải làm gì cho con trai tôi đây?"'

decisions.choice: Rachel's tomb, on the border of Benjamin, at a place called Zelzah
decisions.reason: Rachel, the mother of Benjamin, died on the road near Ephrath and was buried there (Genesis 35:16-20; 48:7). This verse places her tomb in the territory of Benjamin, which fits a site north of Jerusalem near the border; Jeremiah 31:15 also links Rachel with Ramah in Benjamin. Zelzah is named only here, and where it was is not known.

decisions.choice: has left off the matter of the donkeys: has stopped caring about them
decisions.reason: The verb means to let go or abandon. Kish has given up worrying about the lost animals (9:3-5) and is now anxious about his son, as Saul himself had feared in 9:5.

decisions.choice: the father's words are quoted inside the men's message
decisions.reason: The men report what Kish is saying, so his words stand as a quotation within their words, which stand within Samuel's.

decisions.choice: the place where Rachel is buried (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "tomb" with common words. "He keeps asking" puts the ongoing sense of "saying" (he is anxious and asking) into plain English.

decisions.choice: speech inside speech: «...“...‘...’...”...»; "preocupado por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}" (L, B), "por ti" (R)
decisions.reason: Samuel's words are in «», the men's message inside them in “ ”, and the father's words inside that in ‘ ’ (m3), as Spanish nests quotations. The Hebrew "anxious for you" is plural, Saul and his servant, so Literal and Balanced keep the plural setting; Readable follows the English Readable's "about you" as Saul.

decisions.choice: Raheli; Selsa
decisions.reason: Rachel keeps her published Swahili form "Raheli"; Zelzah takes a Swahili spelling, with "s" for the Hebrew sound as in "Sufu". The father's words inside the men's message take double quotes inside single quotes, as in the English.

decisions.choice: "Ra-chên", "Xên-xa"
decisions.reason: "Ra-chên" is the form of the published Genesis; "Xên-xa" the usual transliteration.

source.text: וְחָלַפְתָּ֨ מִשָּׁ֜ם וָהָ֗לְאָה וּבָ֨אתָ֙ עַד־אֵל֣וֹן תָּב֔וֹר וּמְצָא֤וּךָ שָּׁם֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים עֹלִ֥ים אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים בֵּֽית־אֵ֑ל אֶחָ֞ד נֹשֵׂ֣א׀שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְדָיִ֗ים וְאֶחָד֙ נֹשֵׂ֗א שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת֙ כִּכְּר֣וֹת לֶ֔חֶם וְאֶחָ֥ד נֹשֵׂ֖א נֵֽבֶל־יָֽיִן׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will pass on from there and further, and you will come to [the] oak of Tabor, and will find you there three men going up to God [at] Bethel, one carrying three young goats, and one carrying three round loaves of bread, and one carrying a skin of wine.

en.L: And you will go on from there and farther, and you will come to the oak of Tabor, and three men going up to God [at] Bethel will find you there, one carrying three young goats, and one carrying three round loaves of bread, and one carrying a skin of wine.
en.B: Then you will go on from there until you reach the oak of Tabor. Three men will meet you there on their way up to worship God at Bethel. One will be carrying three young goats, another three loaves of bread, and the third a skin of wine.
en.R: Then you will go on farther and come to the big oak tree at Tabor. There you will meet three men on their way to worship God at Bethel. One of them will be carrying three young goats. Another will be carrying three loaves of bread. The third will be carrying a leather bag full of wine.

es.L: Y seguirás de allí en adelante, y llegarás a la encina de Tabor, y allí te encontrarán tres hombres que suben a Dios [en] Betel, uno llevando tres cabritos, y otro llevando tres tortas de pan, y otro llevando un odre de vino.
es.B: De allí seguirás adelante hasta llegar a la encina de Tabor. Allí te saldrán al paso tres hombres que suben a adorar a Dios en Betel. Uno llevará tres cabritos, otro tres panes, y el tercero un odre de vino.
es.R: Luego seguirás más adelante y llegarás a la gran encina de Tabor. Allí te encontrarás con tres hombres que van a Betel a adorar a Dios. Uno de ellos llevará tres cabritos. Otro llevará tres panes. El tercero llevará una bolsa de cuero llena de vino.

fr.L: Et tu passeras de là plus loin, et tu arriveras au chêne de Tabor, et trois hommes qui montent vers Dieu [à] Béthel te trouveront là, l’un portant trois chevreaux, et l’un portant trois pains ronds, et l’un portant une outre de vin.
fr.B: De là, tu continueras ton chemin jusqu’au chêne de Tabor. Tu y rencontreras trois hommes qui montent adorer Dieu à Béthel. L’un portera trois chevreaux, un autre trois pains, et le troisième une outre de vin.
fr.R: Ensuite, tu iras plus loin et tu arriveras au grand chêne de Tabor. Là, tu rencontreras trois hommes qui vont adorer Dieu à Béthel. L’un d’eux portera trois jeunes chèvres. Un autre portera trois pains. Le troisième portera un sac de cuir rempli de vin.

sw.L: Nawe utapita kutoka huko na kwenda mbele zaidi, nawe utafika kwenye mwaloni wa Tabori, na watu watatu wanaopanda kwenda kwa Mungu [huko] Betheli watakukuta huko, mmoja akibeba wana-mbuzi watatu, na mmoja akibeba mikate mitatu ya mviringo, na mmoja akibeba kiriba cha divai.
sw.B: Kisha utaendelea kutoka huko mpaka ufike kwenye mwaloni wa Tabori. Watu watatu watakutana nawe huko wakiwa njiani kupanda kwenda kumwabudu Mungu huko Betheli. Mmoja atakuwa amebeba wana-mbuzi watatu, mwingine mikate mitatu, na wa tatu kiriba cha divai.
sw.R: Kisha utaendelea mbele na kufika kwenye mti mkubwa wa mwaloni huko Tabori. Huko utakutana na watu watatu wanaokwenda kumwabudu Mungu huko Betheli. Mmoja wao atakuwa amebeba wana-mbuzi watatu. Mwingine atakuwa amebeba mikate mitatu. Wa tatu atakuwa amebeba mfuko wa ngozi uliojaa divai.

vi.L: Từ đó ông sẽ đi tiếp xa hơn nữa, và ông sẽ đến cây sồi Tha-bô; tại đó ba người đang đi lên cùng Đức Chúa Trời [tại] Bê-tên sẽ gặp ông: một người mang ba con dê con, một người mang ba ổ bánh tròn, và một người mang một bầu da rượu.
vi.B: Rồi từ đó ông sẽ đi tiếp cho đến cây sồi Tha-bô. Tại đó ba người đang đi lên Bê-tên thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời sẽ gặp ông. Một người mang ba con dê con, một người mang ba ổ bánh, và người thứ ba mang một bầu da rượu.
vi.R: Rồi ông sẽ đi xa hơn nữa và đến cây sồi lớn ở Tha-bô. Tại đó ông sẽ gặp ba người đang đi lên Bê-tên để thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời. Một người mang ba con dê con. Một người mang ba ổ bánh. Người thứ ba mang một túi da đầy rượu.

decisions.choice: the oak of Tabor: a large tree known as a landmark, at an unknown place
decisions.reason: The word names a great tree, an oak or a terebinth. This Tabor is not Mount Tabor far to the north; it was somewhere between Rachel's tomb and Gibeah, and its site is not known.

decisions.choice: going up to God at Bethel: going to worship at the sanctuary there
decisions.reason: Bethel ("house of God") had been a place of worship since Jacob's time (Genesis 28:19-22; 35:1-7; Judges 20:18, 26). The goats, bread and wine are what the men bring for sacrifice and the meal that went with it.

decisions.choice: to worship
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say why the men are going up to God at Bethel (m2).

decisions.choice: a leather bag full of wine (Readable)
decisions.reason: Wine was carried in a skin bag made from a whole animal hide; Readable says what the "skin" was.

source.text: וְשָׁאֲל֥וּ לְךָ֖ לְשָׁל֑וֹם וְנָתְנ֤וּ לְךָ֙ שְׁתֵּי־לֶ֔חֶם וְלָקַחְתָּ֖ מִיָּדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will ask you of welfare and will give to you two [loaves of] bread, and you will take [them] from their hand.

en.L: And they will ask you about [your] welfare and give you two [loaves] of bread, and you will take [them] from their hand.
en.B: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, and you will accept them from them.
en.R: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, and you will take the bread from them.

es.L: Y te preguntarán por [tu] bienestar y te darán dos [panes], y [los] tomarás de su mano.
es.B: Te saludarán y te darán dos panes, y tú los aceptarás.
es.R: Te saludarán y te darán dos panes, y tú los tomarás.

fr.L: Et ils te demanderont comment tu vas, et te donneront deux [pains], et tu [les] prendras de leur main.
fr.B: Ils te salueront et te donneront deux pains, et tu les accepteras de leur main.
fr.R: Ils te salueront et te donneront deux pains, et tu les prendras.

sw.L: Nao watakuuliza habari za hali [yako] na kukupa mikate miwili, nawe utaipokea kutoka mkononi mwao.
sw.B: Watakusalimu na kukupa mikate miwili, nawe utaipokea kutoka kwao.
sw.R: Watakusalimu na kukupa mikate miwili, nawe utaichukua kutoka kwao.

vi.L: Họ sẽ hỏi thăm ông bình an và cho ông hai [ổ] bánh, và ông hãy nhận từ tay họ.
vi.B: Họ sẽ chào hỏi ông và biếu ông hai ổ bánh, và ông hãy nhận lấy.
vi.R: Họ sẽ chào ông và biếu ông hai ổ bánh, và ông hãy nhận bánh từ tay họ.

decisions.choice: ask you about your welfare: greet you
decisions.reason: The phrase uses the word for peace and well-being; it is the usual way of greeting someone (Genesis 43:27; Judges 18:15).

decisions.choice: the men give part of their offering to Saul
decisions.reason: The bread was meant for the sanctuary, yet they hand two loaves to a stranger. It seems to be a sign of the honor that is now due to the LORD's chosen ruler, and Saul is to accept it.

decisions.choice: greet you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the idiom (m1).

source.text: אַ֣חַר כֵּ֗ן תָּבוֹא֙ גִּבְעַ֣ת הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֖ם נְצִבֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וִיהִי֩ כְבֹאֲךָ֨ שָׁ֜ם הָעִ֗יר וּפָגַעְתָּ֞ חֶ֤בֶל נְבִיאִים֙ יֹרְדִ֣ים מֵֽהַבָּמָ֔ה וְלִפְנֵיהֶ֞ם נֵ֤בֶל וְתֹף֙ וְחָלִ֣יל וְכִנּ֔וֹר וְהֵ֖מָּה מִֽתְנַבְּאִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: After that you will come [to] Gibeah of God, where [are] there [the] garrisons of [the] Philistines, and it will be as you come there [to] the city, and you will meet a band of prophets coming down from the high place, and before them harp and tambourine and flute and lyre, and they [will be] prophesying.

en.L: After that you will come to Gibeah of God, where the garrisons of the Philistines [are], and it will be, as you come there to the city, you will meet a band of prophets coming down from the high place, and before them [will be] harp and tambourine and flute and lyre, and they [will be] prophesying.
en.B: Next you will reach Gibeah of God, where there are Philistine garrisons. Just as you enter the town, you will meet a band of prophets as they come down from the high place. Harp, tambourine, flute and lyre will be going before them, and they will be prophesying.
en.R: After that you will come to Gibeah of God, the hill where the Philistines have soldiers stationed. As you go into the town, you will meet a group of prophets coming down from the hilltop shrine. In front of them people will be playing harps, tambourines, flutes and lyres, and the prophets will be prophesying.

es.L: Después de eso llegarás a Guibeá de Dios, donde [están] las guarniciones de los filisteos, y sucederá que, al entrar allí en la ciudad, te encontrarás con un grupo de profetas que bajan del lugar alto, y delante de ellos arpa y pandero y flauta y lira, y ellos [estarán] profetizando.
es.B: Luego llegarás a Guibeá de Dios, donde hay guarniciones filisteas. Justo al entrar en la ciudad, te encontrarás con un grupo de profetas que bajan del lugar alto. Delante de ellos irán arpa, pandero, flauta y lira, y ellos estarán profetizando.
es.R: Después llegarás a Guibeá de Dios, la colina donde los filisteos tienen soldados. Al entrar en la ciudad, te encontrarás con un grupo de profetas que bajan del santuario de la colina. Delante de ellos habrá gente tocando arpas, panderos, flautas y liras, y los profetas estarán profetizando.

fr.L: Après cela, tu arriveras à Guibea de Dieu, où [sont] les postes des Philistins ; et il arrivera, quand tu entreras là, dans la ville, que tu rencontreras une troupe de prophètes descendant du haut lieu, et devant eux harpe, tambourin, flûte et lyre, et ils prophétiseront.
fr.B: Ensuite, tu arriveras à Guibea de Dieu, où se trouvent des postes de soldats philistins. Au moment où tu entreras dans la ville, tu rencontreras une troupe de prophètes qui descendront du haut lieu, précédés de harpes, de tambourins, de flûtes et de lyres ; ils prophétiseront.
fr.R: Après cela, tu arriveras à Guibea de Dieu, la colline où les Philistins ont installé des soldats. En entrant dans la ville, tu rencontreras un groupe de prophètes qui descendront du sanctuaire sur la colline. Devant eux, des gens joueront de la harpe, du tambourin, de la flûte et de la lyre, et les prophètes prophétiseront.

sw.L: Baada ya hapo utafika Gibea ya Mungu, mahali zilipo ngome za Wafilisti, na itakuwa, utakapoingia huko mjini, utakutana na kundi la manabii wakishuka kutoka mahali pa juu, na mbele yao [kutakuwa na] kinubi na matari na filimbi na zeze, nao [watakuwa] wakitabiri.
sw.B: Kisha utafika Gibea ya Mungu, mahali palipo na vituo vya askari wa Wafilisti. Mara utakapoingia mjini, utakutana na kundi la manabii wakishuka kutoka mahali pa juu. Kinubi, matari, filimbi na zeze vitakuwa vikiwatangulia, nao watakuwa wakitabiri.
sw.R: Baada ya hapo utafika Gibea ya Mungu, kilima ambapo Wafilisti wameweka askari wao. Utakapoingia mjini, utakutana na kundi la manabii wakishuka kutoka patakatifu pa kilimani. Mbele yao watu watakuwa wakipiga vinubi, matari, filimbi na zeze, na manabii watakuwa wakitabiri.

vi.L: Sau đó ông sẽ đến Ghi-bê-a của Đức Chúa Trời, nơi có các đồn binh của người Phi-li-tin. Khi ông vào đến thành, ông sẽ gặp một đoàn tiên tri đang từ nơi cao đi xuống, trước mặt họ [có] đàn hạc, trống cơm, sáo và đàn lia, và họ [đang] nói tiên tri.
vi.B: Kế đó ông sẽ đến Ghi-bê-a của Đức Chúa Trời, nơi có đồn binh Phi-li-tin. Vừa vào thành, ông sẽ gặp một đoàn tiên tri từ nơi cao đi xuống. Đàn hạc, trống cơm, sáo và đàn lia đi trước họ, và họ đang nói tiên tri.
vi.R: Sau đó ông sẽ đến Ghi-bê-a của Đức Chúa Trời, là ngọn đồi nơi người Phi-li-tin đóng quân. Khi vào thành, ông sẽ gặp một đoàn tiên tri từ nơi cao đi xuống. Phía trước họ có người chơi đàn hạc, trống cơm, sáo và đàn lia, và các nhà tiên tri đang nói tiên tri.

decisions.choice: Gibeah of God: "the hill of God", a hill town with a place of worship
decisions.reason: Gibeah means "hill". The name may point to the high place there. It may be Saul's own town of Gibeah (verses 10, 26; 11:4), or a separate place nearby; the text does not say.

decisions.choice: garrisons: posts of Philistine troops
decisions.reason: The word can mean a garrison or outpost, an officer set over a district, or a pillar set up as a sign of rule. Any of these shows that the Philistines held power in Benjamin, which Jonathan challenges in 13:3.

decisions.choice: the high place: a local hilltop place of worship
decisions.reason: Before the temple was built, Israel worshiped the LORD at local high places, as Samuel did in 9:12-14 (1 Kings 3:2).

decisions.choice: a band of prophets prophesying: a group speaking or singing under the power of God's Spirit
decisions.reason: Here prophesying is not foretelling. It is inspired speech or praise, led by music and shared by the group, as with the elders in Numbers 11:25-27 and the prophets with Samuel in 19:20-24. Music goes with prophesying again in 2 Kings 3:15 and 1 Chronicles 25:1.

decisions.choice: hilltop shrine (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in the book-wide wording, Readable explains "high place".

decisions.choice: people will be playing (Readable); going before them (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew simply lists the instruments "before them"; Balanced and Readable say that they were being played ahead of the procession.

decisions.choice: "une troupe de prophètes" (Literal, Balanced); "un groupe de prophètes" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: "troupe" says a company moving together; French "bande" now suggests a gang.

decisions.choice: "un grupo de profetas"; "Guibeá"
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel, as the Samuel terms note: the band of prophets is "un grupo de profetas" at every level, and Gibeah is "Guibeá".

decisions.choice: kundi la manabii; wakitabiri
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: a band of prophets is "kundi la manabii" at every level; their prophesying is "kutabiri", the word for speaking under God's Spirit (m4).

decisions.choice: "một đoàn tiên tri" for a band of prophets; "Ghi-bê-a"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note.

source.text: וְצָלְחָ֤ה עָלֶ֨יךָ֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה וְהִתְנַבִּ֖יתָ עִמָּ֑ם וְנֶהְפַּכְתָּ֖ לְאִ֥ישׁ אַחֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And will rush on you [the] Spirit of Yahweh, and you will prophesy with them, and you will be turned into another man.

en.L: And the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will rush on you, and you will prophesy with them, and you will be turned into another man.
en.B: The Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will rush on you, and you will prophesy with them and be changed into a different man.
en.R: Then the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will rush on you. You will prophesy with them, and you will become a different person.

es.L: Y el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vendrá con poder sobre ti, y profetizarás con ellos, y serás cambiado en otro hombre.
es.B: El Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vendrá con poder sobre ti, y profetizarás con ellos y te convertirás en un hombre distinto.
es.R: Entonces el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vendrá con poder sobre ti. Profetizarás con ellos, y serás una persona diferente.

fr.L: Et l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fondra sur toi, et tu prophétiseras avec eux, et tu seras changé en un autre homme.
fr.B: L’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fondra sur toi ; tu prophétiseras avec eux et tu seras changé en un autre homme.
fr.R: Alors l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} viendra sur toi avec puissance. Tu prophétiseras avec eux, et tu deviendras une autre personne.

sw.L: Na Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakujia kwa nguvu, nawe utatabiri pamoja nao, nawe utageuzwa kuwa mtu mwingine.
sw.B: Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakujia kwa nguvu, nawe utatabiri pamoja nao na kubadilishwa kuwa mtu tofauti.
sw.R: Ndipo Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakujia kwa nguvu. Utatabiri pamoja nao, nawe utakuwa mtu tofauti.

vi.L: Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giáng mạnh trên ông, ông sẽ nói tiên tri với họ, và ông sẽ được biến đổi thành một người khác.
vi.B: Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giáng mạnh trên ông; ông sẽ nói tiên tri với họ và được biến đổi thành một người khác.
vi.R: Bấy giờ Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giáng mạnh trên ông. Ông sẽ nói tiên tri với họ, và ông sẽ trở thành một con người khác.

decisions.choice: the Spirit of the LORD will rush on you: will come on you suddenly and with power
decisions.reason: The same verb is used when the Spirit came on Samson (Judges 14:6, 19; 15:14), and it returns in verse 10 and in 11:6 and 16:13. As with the judges, the Spirit gives Saul a power beyond his own.

decisions.choice: turned into another man: given a new capacity from God
decisions.reason: The change is the work of God (verse 9). It fits Saul for the task he has been given; it does not say that his whole character was made new for ever, as the later chapters show (16:14).

decisions.choice: be changed into a different man (Balanced); become a different person (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Another man" here means a man made different, so Balanced and Readable say "different".

decisions.choice: "l’Esprit du SEIGNEUR fondra sur toi" (Literal, Balanced); "viendra sur toi avec puissance" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note settles: "fondre sur" keeps the sudden, powerful coming of the Spirit (m1); Readable says it in plainer words.

decisions.choice: "vendrá con poder sobre"
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel, as the Samuel terms note: the verb of the Spirit's sudden and forceful coming (m1) is "venir con poder sobre" at every level.

decisions.choice: Roho wa BWANA atakujia kwa nguvu
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: the Spirit "rushing on" someone is "Roho wa BWANA ... -jia kwa nguvu" at every level; "Roho" takes personal agreement ("atakujia"), as in the Swahili New Testament.

decisions.choice: "Thần Linh của CHÚA giáng mạnh trên"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note, after the Vietnamese Psalm 139:7 for "the Spirit of God"; "Đức Thánh Linh" is kept for the New Testament's Holy Spirit.

source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּ֥י תָבֹ֛אנָה הָאֹת֥וֹת הָאֵ֖לֶּה לָ֑ךְ עֲשֵׂ֤ה לְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּמְצָ֣א יָדֶ֔ךָ כִּ֥י הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, when come these signs to you, do for yourself what will find your hand, for God [is] with you.

en.L: And it will be, when these signs come to you, do for yourself whatever your hand finds, for God [is] with you.
en.B: When these signs have happened to you, do whatever the moment calls for, for God is with you.
en.R: When all these signs have come true, do whatever you see needs to be done. God is with you.

es.L: Y sucederá que, cuando te sobrevengan estas señales, haz lo que halle tu mano, porque Dios [está] contigo.
es.B: Cuando se cumplan estas señales, haz lo que la ocasión requiera, porque Dios está contigo.
es.R: Cuando todas estas señales se hayan cumplido, haz lo que veas que hay que hacer. Dios está contigo.

fr.L: Et il arrivera, quand ces signes te seront arrivés, fais ce que ta main trouvera, car Dieu [est] avec toi.
fr.B: Quand ces signes se seront réalisés pour toi, fais ce que les circonstances demanderont, car Dieu est avec toi.
fr.R: Quand tous ces signes se seront réalisés, fais ce que tu jugeras nécessaire. Dieu est avec toi.

sw.L: Na itakuwa, ishara hizi zitakapokujia, jifanyie lolote ambalo mkono wako utaliona, kwa maana Mungu [yu] pamoja nawe.
sw.B: Ishara hizi zikishakutokea, fanya lolote ambalo wakati huo unadai, kwa maana Mungu yu pamoja nawe.
sw.R: Ishara hizi zote zikishatimia, fanya lolote unaloona linahitaji kufanywa. Mungu yu pamoja nawe.

vi.L: Khi những dấu hiệu này đến với ông, hãy làm điều gì tay ông tìm thấy, vì Đức Chúa Trời [ở] với ông.
vi.B: Khi những dấu hiệu này đã xảy đến cho ông, hãy làm điều gì thời cơ đòi hỏi, vì Đức Chúa Trời ở cùng ông.
vi.R: Khi tất cả những dấu hiệu này đã xảy ra, hãy làm điều gì ông thấy cần phải làm. Đức Chúa Trời ở cùng ông.

decisions.choice: do whatever your hand finds: act as the opportunity comes
decisions.reason: The same phrase is used in Judges 9:33 and Ecclesiastes 9:10. Samuel gives Saul freedom to act when the time comes. It may hint at action against the Philistine garrison just mentioned (verse 5; compare 13:3), but the text does not say so.

decisions.choice: God is with you
decisions.reason: The promise given to Moses, Joshua and Gideon (Exodus 3:12; Joshua 1:5; Judges 6:12, 16) is now given to Saul; it is the reason he can act with confidence.

decisions.choice: "they come": the form to be read aloud
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text and the form marked to be read aloud spell this verb slightly differently. The meaning is the same either way.

decisions.choice: whatever the moment calls for (Balanced); whatever you see needs to be done (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom (m1).

source.text: וְיָרַדְתָּ֣ לְפָנַי֮ הַגִּלְגָּל֒ וְהִנֵּ֤ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ יֹרֵ֣ד אֵלֶ֔יךָ לְהַעֲל֣וֹת עֹל֔וֹת לִזְבֹּ֖חַ זִבְחֵ֣י שְׁלָמִ֑ים שִׁבְעַ֨ת יָמִ֤ים תּוֹחֵל֙ עַד־בּוֹאִ֣י אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְהוֹדַעְתִּ֣י לְךָ֔ אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will go down before me [to] Gilgal, and look, I [am] coming down to you to offer up burnt offerings, to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings; seven days you will wait until my coming to you, and I will make known to you what you will do.

en.L: And you shall go down ahead of me to Gilgal, and look, I [am] coming down to you to offer up burnt offerings [and] to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings. Seven days you shall wait, until I come to you, and I will make known to you what you shall do."
en.B: Then go down to Gilgal before me. I will come down to join you there, to offer burnt offerings and sacrifice peace offerings. You must wait seven days for me to come, and then I will make known to you what you should do."
en.R: Go down to Gilgal ahead of me. I will come there to offer burnt offerings and peace offerings. Wait seven days until I come to you. Then I will tell you what to do."

es.L: Y bajarás delante de mí a Gilgal, y he aquí, yo bajaré a ti para ofrecer holocaustos [y] sacrificar sacrificios de paz. Siete días esperarás, hasta que yo venga a ti, y te haré saber lo que has de hacer».
es.B: Después baja a Gilgal antes que yo. Yo bajaré allí a reunirme contigo para ofrecer holocaustos y sacrificios de paz. Debes esperar siete días hasta que yo llegue, y entonces te haré saber lo que tienes que hacer».
es.R: Baja a Gilgal antes que yo. Yo iré allá a ofrecer holocaustos y sacrificios de paz. Espera siete días hasta que yo llegue. Entonces te diré lo que tienes que hacer».

fr.L: Et tu descendras avant moi à Guilgal, et voici, je descends vers toi pour offrir des holocaustes [et] pour sacrifier des sacrifices de communion. Sept jours tu attendras, jusqu’à ce que je vienne vers toi, et je te ferai connaître ce que tu feras. »
fr.B: Puis descends avant moi à Guilgal. Je viendrai t’y rejoindre pour offrir des holocaustes et des sacrifices de communion. Tu attendras sept jours que j’arrive, et je te ferai connaître ce que tu devras faire. »
fr.R: Descends à Guilgal avant moi. J’y viendrai pour offrir des sacrifices complets par le feu et des sacrifices de communion. Attends sept jours que j’arrive. Ensuite, je te dirai ce que tu dois faire. »

sw.L: Nawe utashuka mbele yangu Gilgali, na tazama, mimi [ninakuja] kwako ili kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa [na] kutoa dhabihu za sadaka za amani. Siku saba utasubiri, mpaka nitakapokuja kwako, nami nitakujulisha utakalofanya."
sw.B: Kisha shuka Gilgali kabla yangu. Nitashuka nikujie huko ili kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na kutoa dhabihu za sadaka za amani. Ni lazima usubiri siku saba mpaka nitakapokuja, kisha nitakujulisha unalopaswa kufanya."
sw.R: Shuka Gilgali kabla yangu. Nitakuja huko kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani. Subiri siku saba mpaka nitakapokuja kwako. Kisha nitakuambia la kufanya."

vi.L: Ông hãy đi xuống Ghinh-ganh trước tôi; kìa, tôi sẽ xuống cùng ông để dâng các tế lễ thiêu [và] dâng các sinh tế bình an. Ông hãy đợi bảy ngày, cho đến khi tôi đến cùng ông, và tôi sẽ cho ông biết điều ông phải làm."
vi.B: Rồi ông hãy đi xuống Ghinh-ganh trước tôi. Tôi sẽ xuống đó gặp ông để dâng tế lễ thiêu và sinh tế bình an. Ông phải đợi bảy ngày cho đến khi tôi đến, rồi tôi sẽ cho ông biết điều ông phải làm."
vi.R: Hãy đi xuống Ghinh-ganh trước tôi. Tôi sẽ đến đó để dâng tế lễ thiêu và tế lễ bình an. Hãy đợi bảy ngày cho đến khi tôi đến gặp ông. Rồi tôi sẽ cho ông biết phải làm gì."

decisions.choice: seven days you shall wait: the instruction Saul later breaks
decisions.reason: In 13:8-14 Saul waits seven days at Gilgal, but when Samuel is late he offers the burnt offering himself, and Samuel rebukes him. The instruction given here is the background to that failure.

decisions.choice: Gilgal; burnt offerings and peace offerings
decisions.reason: Gilgal, near Jericho, was where Israel first camped in the land (Joshua 4:19-20), and Saul's kingship is renewed there in 11:14-15. Burnt offerings were burned whole; in peace offerings part was eaten by the worshipers in a shared meal (Leviticus 1; 3).

decisions.choice: you shall go down: an instruction for a later time
decisions.reason: The verb form continues Samuel's words about the future; here it is an instruction rather than a prediction. It does not say when Saul is to go; 13:8 shows it was later, after he had become king.

decisions.choice: go down; wait (commands)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the instruction as a command.

source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה כְּהַפְנֹת֤וֹ שִׁכְמוֹ֙ לָלֶ֨כֶת֙ מֵעִ֣ם שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיַּהֲפָךְ־ל֥וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֵ֣ב אַחֵ֑ר וַיָּבֹ֛אוּ כָּל־הָאֹת֥וֹת הָאֵ֖לֶּה בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And it was, as he turned his shoulder to go from with Samuel, and changed for him God another heart, and came all these signs on that day.

en.L: And it happened, as he turned his shoulder to go from Samuel, God changed for him [his heart into] another heart, and all these signs came [to pass] on that day.
en.B: As Saul turned to leave Samuel, God changed his heart, and all these signs came true that day.
en.R: As soon as Saul turned to leave Samuel, God gave him a new heart. And all the signs Samuel had told him about happened that day.

es.L: Y sucedió que, al volver él la espalda para irse de Samuel, Dios le cambió [el corazón en] otro corazón, y todas estas señales se cumplieron aquel día.
es.B: En cuanto Saúl se dio la vuelta para separarse de Samuel, Dios le cambió el corazón, y todas aquellas señales se cumplieron ese mismo día.
es.R: En cuanto Saúl se dio la vuelta para irse, Dios le dio un corazón nuevo. Y ese mismo día sucedieron todas las señales que Samuel le había dicho.

fr.L: Et il arriva, comme il tournait l’épaule pour s’en aller d’auprès de Samuel, que Dieu lui changea [le cœur en] un autre cœur, et tous ces signes arrivèrent ce jour-là.
fr.B: Comme Saül se détournait pour quitter Samuel, Dieu changea son cœur, et tous ces signes se réalisèrent ce jour-là.
fr.R: Dès que Saül s’est détourné pour quitter Samuel, Dieu lui a donné un cœur nouveau. Et tous les signes que Samuel lui avait annoncés se sont réalisés ce jour-là.

sw.L: Na ikawa, alipogeuza bega lake ili kuondoka kwa Samweli, Mungu akambadilishia [moyo wake kuwa] moyo mwingine, na ishara hizi zote zikatokea siku ile.
sw.B: Sauli alipogeuka kumwacha Samweli, Mungu akambadilisha moyo, na ishara hizo zote zikatimia siku ile.
sw.R: Mara Sauli alipogeuka kumwacha Samweli, Mungu akampa moyo mpya. Na ishara zote ambazo Samweli alikuwa amemwambia zikatokea siku ile.

vi.L: Khi ông vừa quay lưng rời khỏi Sa-mu-ên, Đức Chúa Trời đổi [lòng] ông thành một lòng khác, và mọi dấu hiệu ấy đều xảy ra trong ngày ấy.
vi.B: Khi Sau-lơ quay đi để rời Sa-mu-ên, Đức Chúa Trời đổi lòng ông, và mọi dấu hiệu ấy đều ứng nghiệm trong ngày hôm đó.
vi.R: Vừa khi Sau-lơ quay đi để rời Sa-mu-ên, Đức Chúa Trời ban cho ông một tấm lòng mới. Và mọi dấu hiệu Sa-mu-ên đã nói với ông đều xảy ra trong ngày hôm ấy.

decisions.choice: turned his shoulder: turned his back, turned away
decisions.reason: The picture is of someone turning around to leave.

decisions.choice: God changed his heart: God gave him a new inner self, mind and will
decisions.reason: The heart is the center of thought and will. The word "another" repeats verse 6 ("another man"). What Samuel promised, God does, and the verse says it happened as soon as Saul left.

decisions.choice: all these signs came true that day: a summary
decisions.reason: The verse sums up all three signs; verses 10-13 then tell only the last one in detail.

decisions.choice: the signs Samuel had told him about (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable reminds the reader which signs are meant.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֤אוּ שָׁם֙ הַגִּבְעָ֔תָה וְהִנֵּ֥ה חֶֽבֶל־נְבִאִ֖ים לִקְרָאת֑וֹ וַתִּצְלַ֤ח עָלָיו֙ ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיִּתְנַבֵּ֖א בְּתוֹכָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they came there to Gibeah, and look, a band of prophets to meet him, and rushed on him [the] Spirit of God, and he prophesied in their midst.

en.L: And they came there to Gibeah, and look, a band of prophets [was coming] to meet him, and the Spirit of God rushed on him, and he prophesied in their midst.
en.B: When they came to Gibeah, a band of prophets met him there. The Spirit of God rushed on him, and he prophesied among them.
en.R: When Saul and his servant came to Gibeah, a group of prophets came to meet him. The Spirit of God rushed on him, and he prophesied along with them.

es.L: Y llegaron allá, a Guibeá, y he aquí, un grupo de profetas [venía] a su encuentro, y el Espíritu de Dios vino con poder sobre él, y profetizó en medio de ellos.
es.B: Cuando llegaron a Guibeá, un grupo de profetas salió a su encuentro. El Espíritu de Dios vino con poder sobre él, y profetizó entre ellos.
es.R: Cuando Saúl y su criado llegaron a Guibeá, un grupo de profetas salió a recibirlo. El Espíritu de Dios vino con poder sobre él, y profetizó junto con ellos.

fr.L: Et ils arrivèrent là, à Guibea, et voici, une troupe de prophètes [venait] à sa rencontre ; et l’Esprit de Dieu fondit sur lui, et il prophétisa au milieu d’eux.
fr.B: Quand ils arrivèrent à Guibea, une troupe de prophètes vint à sa rencontre. L’Esprit de Dieu fondit sur lui, et il prophétisa au milieu d’eux.
fr.R: Quand Saül et son serviteur sont arrivés à Guibea, un groupe de prophètes est venu à sa rencontre. L’Esprit de Dieu est venu sur lui avec puissance, et il a prophétisé avec eux.

sw.L: Nao walipofika huko Gibea, tazama, kundi la manabii [lilikuja] kumlaki, na Roho wa Mungu akamjia kwa nguvu, naye akatabiri katikati yao.
sw.B: Walipofika Gibea, kundi la manabii likakutana naye huko. Roho wa Mungu akamjia kwa nguvu, naye akatabiri kati yao.
sw.R: Sauli na mtumishi wake walipofika Gibea, kundi la manabii likaja kumlaki. Roho wa Mungu akamjia kwa nguvu, naye akatabiri pamoja nao.

vi.L: Họ đến đó, tại Ghi-bê-a, và kìa, một đoàn tiên tri [đến] gặp ông; Thần Linh của Đức Chúa Trời giáng mạnh trên ông, và ông nói tiên tri giữa họ.
vi.B: Khi họ đến Ghi-bê-a, một đoàn tiên tri ra gặp ông. Thần Linh của Đức Chúa Trời giáng mạnh trên ông, và ông nói tiên tri giữa họ.
vi.R: Khi Sau-lơ và người đầy tớ đến Ghi-bê-a, một đoàn tiên tri ra gặp ông. Thần Linh của Đức Chúa Trời giáng mạnh trên ông, và ông nói tiên tri cùng với họ.

decisions.choice: the Spirit of God rushed on him
decisions.reason: The promise of verse 6 is fulfilled in the same words, with "God" here in place of "the LORD"; the same Spirit is meant.

decisions.choice: they: Saul and his servant
decisions.reason: The servant has been with Saul since 9:3 and is with him again in verse 14.

decisions.choice: Saul and his servant (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable names who "they" are (m2).

source.text: וַיְהִ֗י כָּל־יֽוֹדְעוֹ֙ מֵאִתְּמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשׁ֔וֹם וַיִּרְא֕וּ וְהִנֵּ֥ה עִם־נְבִאִ֖ים נִבָּ֑א וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הָעָ֜ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵ֗הוּ מַה־זֶּה֙ הָיָ֣ה לְבֶן־קִ֔ישׁ הֲגַ֥ם שָׁא֖וּל בַּנְּבִיאִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, all knowing him from yesterday [and] three days ago saw, and look, with prophets he was prophesying, and said the people each to his neighbor, what [is] this [that] has happened to the son of Kish? [is] also Saul among the prophets?

en.L: And it happened, when all who had known him before saw, and look, he was prophesying with prophets, that the people said each to his neighbor, "What [is] this [that] has happened to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?"
en.B: When all who had known him before saw him prophesying with the prophets, the people asked one another, "What has come over the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?"
en.R: Everyone who had known Saul before saw him prophesying with the prophets. They asked each other, "What has happened to Kish's son? Is even Saul one of the prophets?"

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando todos los que lo conocían de antes vieron que, he aquí, profetizaba con los profetas, el pueblo se dijo unos a otros: «¿Qué [es] esto [que] le ha sucedido al hijo de Cis? ¿También Saúl [está] entre los profetas?».
es.B: Cuando todos los que lo conocían de antes lo vieron profetizar con los profetas, la gente se preguntaba: «¿Qué le ha pasado al hijo de Cis? ¿También Saúl está entre los profetas?».
es.R: Todos los que conocían a Saúl de antes lo vieron profetizar con los profetas. Se preguntaban unos a otros: «¿Qué le ha pasado al hijo de Cis? ¿Hasta Saúl es uno de los profetas?».

fr.L: Et il arriva que tous ceux qui le connaissaient depuis hier [et] avant-hier virent, et voici, il prophétisait avec des prophètes ; et le peuple se dit l’un à l’autre : « Qu’[est-ce] donc [qui] est arrivé au fils de Kis ? Saül aussi [est-il] parmi les prophètes ? »
fr.B: Quand tous ceux qui le connaissaient depuis longtemps le virent prophétiser avec les prophètes, les gens se dirent les uns aux autres : « Que s’est-il passé pour le fils de Kis ? Saül aussi est-il parmi les prophètes ? »
fr.R: Tous ceux qui connaissaient Saül depuis longtemps l’ont vu prophétiser avec les prophètes. Ils se sont demandé les uns aux autres : « Qu’est-il arrivé au fils de Kis ? Même Saül est un des prophètes ? »

sw.L: Na ikawa, wote waliomjua tangu jana na juzi walipoona, na tazama, alikuwa akitabiri pamoja na manabii, watu wakasemezana kila mmoja na mwenzake, "Ni nini [hiki kilichompata] mwana wa Kishi? Je, Sauli naye yumo kati ya manabii?"
sw.B: Wote waliomjua tangu zamani walipomwona akitabiri pamoja na manabii, watu wakaulizana, "Mwana wa Kishi amepatwa na nini? Je, Sauli naye yumo kati ya manabii?"
sw.R: Kila mtu aliyemjua Sauli zamani alimwona akitabiri pamoja na manabii. Wakaulizana, "Mwana wa Kishi amepatwa na nini? Je, hata Sauli ni mmoja wa manabii?"

vi.L: Khi mọi người biết ông từ trước thấy, kìa, ông đang nói tiên tri với các nhà tiên tri, thì dân chúng nói với nhau: "Chuyện gì đã xảy đến cho con trai Kích vậy? Sau-lơ cũng ở trong số các nhà tiên tri sao?"
vi.B: Khi mọi người quen biết ông từ trước thấy ông nói tiên tri với các nhà tiên tri, họ hỏi nhau: "Con trai Kích bị làm sao vậy? Sau-lơ cũng ở trong số các nhà tiên tri sao?"
vi.R: Mọi người quen biết Sau-lơ từ trước thấy ông nói tiên tri với các nhà tiên tri. Họ hỏi nhau: "Có chuyện gì xảy ra cho con trai ông Kích vậy? Ngay cả Sau-lơ cũng là nhà tiên tri sao?"

decisions.choice: from yesterday and three days ago: from before, from the past
decisions.reason: The phrase means "formerly" (Genesis 31:2; Exodus 5:7). These are people who had known Saul for a long time.

decisions.choice: the son of Kish: Saul named by his family
decisions.reason: Naming him by his father points to what people knew of him: a farmer's son from an ordinary family (9:1-3, 21), not a man they expected among the prophets.

decisions.choice: Is Saul also among the prophets?: a question of surprise
decisions.reason: The people cannot believe what they see. Verse 12 says the question became a proverb.

decisions.choice: Is even Saul one of the prophets? (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable puts the surprise of "also" into "even" and uses common words; it keeps the same wording in verse 12.

source.text: וַיַּ֨עַן אִ֥ישׁ מִשָּׁ֛ם וַיֹּ֖אמֶר וּמִ֣י אֲבִיהֶ֑ם עַל־כֵּן֙ הָיְתָ֣ה לְמָשָׁ֔ל הֲגַ֥ם שָׁא֖וּל בַּנְּבִאִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And answered a man from there and said, and who [is] their father? Therefore it became a proverb, [is] also Saul among the prophets?

en.L: And a man from there answered and said, "And who [is] their father?" Therefore it became a proverb: "Is Saul also among the prophets?"
en.B: A man who lived there answered, "And who is their father?" That is how the saying came about: "Is Saul also among the prophets?"
en.R: A man from that place answered, "And who is the father of these prophets?" That is why people started to say, "Is even Saul one of the prophets?"

es.L: Y un hombre de allí respondió y dijo: «¿Y quién [es] el padre de ellos?». Por eso se hizo proverbio: «¿También Saúl [está] entre los profetas?».
es.B: Un hombre del lugar respondió: «¿Y quién es el padre de ellos?». Así nació el dicho: «¿También Saúl está entre los profetas?».
es.R: Un hombre de aquel lugar respondió: «¿Y quién es el padre de estos profetas?». Por eso la gente empezó a decir: «¿Hasta Saúl es uno de los profetas?».

fr.L: Et un homme de là répondit et dit : « Et qui [est] leur père ? » C’est pourquoi c’est devenu un proverbe : « Saül aussi [est-il] parmi les prophètes ? »
fr.B: Un homme de l’endroit répondit : « Et qui est leur père ? » C’est de là que vient le proverbe : « Saül aussi est-il parmi les prophètes ? »
fr.R: Un homme de l’endroit a répondu : « Et qui est le père de ces prophètes ? » Voilà pourquoi les gens ont pris l’habitude de dire : « Même Saül est un des prophètes ? »

sw.L: Na mtu mmoja wa huko akajibu, akasema, "Na baba yao [ni] nani?" Kwa hiyo ikawa methali: "Je, Sauli naye yumo kati ya manabii?"
sw.B: Mtu mmoja aliyeishi huko akajibu, "Na baba yao ni nani?" Ndivyo methali hii ilivyoanza: "Je, Sauli naye yumo kati ya manabii?"
sw.R: Mtu mmoja wa mahali hapo akajibu, "Na baba wa manabii hawa ni nani?" Ndiyo sababu watu walianza kusema, "Je, hata Sauli ni mmoja wa manabii?"

vi.L: Một người ở đó đáp: "Thế cha của họ [là] ai?" Vì vậy mới thành câu tục ngữ: "Sau-lơ cũng ở trong số các nhà tiên tri sao?"
vi.B: Một người ở đó đáp: "Thế còn cha của họ là ai?" Vì thế mới có câu tục ngữ: "Sau-lơ cũng ở trong số các nhà tiên tri sao?"
vi.R: Một người ở đó đáp: "Thế cha của những nhà tiên tri này là ai?" Vì thế người ta bắt đầu nói: "Ngay cả Sau-lơ cũng là nhà tiên tri sao?"

decisions.choice: who is their father?: who are the prophets' parents anyway?
alternatives: prophets have no special family, so why not Saul?
decisions.reason: The meaning of the reply is not certain. It may mean that prophets do not come from any special family, so a son of Kish can be one as well as anyone. "Father" may also mean the leader of a group of prophets (compare 2 Kings 2:12), so the man may be asking who leads them. Or it may be scorn for the prophets themselves. The words allow all three.

decisions.choice: their father: the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation reads "who is his father?", as though the speaker meant Kish. The Hebrew "their father", meaning the prophets', is followed.

decisions.choice: it became a proverb: a saying used when someone shows up where nobody expects him
decisions.reason: The question passed into common speech for a surprising change in a person. 19:24 tells a second occasion when it was said of Saul.

decisions.choice: the father of these prophets (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says whose father "their" refers to.

source.text: וַיְכַל֙ מֵֽהִתְנַבּ֔וֹת וַיָּבֹ֖א הַבָּמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he finished from prophesying and came [to] the high place.

en.L: And he finished prophesying and came to the high place.
en.B: When he had finished prophesying, he went to the high place.
en.R: When Saul stopped prophesying, he went to the hilltop shrine.

es.L: Y terminó de profetizar y llegó al lugar alto.
es.B: Cuando terminó de profetizar, se fue al lugar alto.
es.R: Cuando Saúl dejó de profetizar, se fue al santuario de la colina.

fr.L: Et il acheva de prophétiser et vint au haut lieu.
fr.B: Quand il eut fini de prophétiser, il se rendit au haut lieu.
fr.R: Quand Saül a arrêté de prophétiser, il est allé au sanctuaire sur la colline.

sw.L: Naye akamaliza kutabiri, akaja mahali pa juu.
sw.B: Alipomaliza kutabiri, akaenda mahali pa juu.
sw.R: Sauli alipoacha kutabiri, alikwenda patakatifu pa kilimani.

vi.L: Ông thôi nói tiên tri và đến nơi cao.
vi.B: Khi đã nói tiên tri xong, ông đi lên nơi cao.
vi.R: Khi Sau-lơ thôi nói tiên tri, ông đi lên nơi cao.

decisions.choice: to the high place: the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation has "to the hill", that is, to Gibeah; some have suggested the Hebrew first read "home", which would lead into the conversation with his uncle in verse 14. The Hebrew is followed: the band of prophets had come down from the high place (verse 5), and Saul goes up there.

decisions.choice: hilltop shrine (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 5.

source.text: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ דּ֨וֹד שָׁא֥וּל אֵלָ֛יו וְאֶֽל־נַעֲר֖וֹ אָ֣ן הֲלַכְתֶּ֑ם וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לְבַקֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־הָ֣אֲתֹנ֔וֹת וַנִּרְאֶ֣ה כִי־אַ֔יִן וַנָּב֖וֹא אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And said [the] uncle of Saul to him and to his young man, where did you go? And he said, to seek the donkeys, and we saw that [they were] not, and we came to Samuel.

en.L: And Saul's uncle said to him and to his young man, "Where did you go?" And he said, "To look for the donkeys, and when we saw that [they were] not [there], we came to Samuel."
en.B: Saul's uncle asked him and his servant, "Where have you been?" "Looking for the donkeys," Saul said. "When we saw they were nowhere to be found, we went to Samuel."
en.R: Saul's uncle asked Saul and his servant, "Where did you go?" Saul answered, "We went to look for the donkeys. When we could not find them, we went to see Samuel."

es.L: Y el tío de Saúl le dijo a él y a su muchacho: «¿Adónde {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}}?». Y él dijo: «A buscar las asnas, y cuando vimos que no [estaban], fuimos a Samuel».
es.B: El tío de Saúl les preguntó a él y a su criado: «¿Dónde {{plural_you:han estado|habéis estado}}?». «Buscando las burras», respondió Saúl. «Como vimos que no aparecían por ninguna parte, fuimos a ver a Samuel».
es.R: El tío de Saúl les preguntó a Saúl y a su criado: «¿Adónde {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}}?». Saúl respondió: «Fuimos a buscar las burras. Como no las encontramos, fuimos a ver a Samuel».

fr.L: Et l’oncle de Saül lui dit, à lui et à son jeune homme : « Où êtes-vous allés ? » Et il dit : « Chercher les ânesses ; et quand nous avons vu qu’[elles n’étaient] pas [là], nous sommes allés vers Samuel. »
fr.B: L’oncle de Saül lui demanda, ainsi qu’à son serviteur : « Où êtes-vous allés ? » « Chercher les ânesses, répondit Saül. Quand nous avons vu qu’elles restaient introuvables, nous sommes allés voir Samuel. »
fr.R: L’oncle de Saül leur a demandé, à lui et à son serviteur : « Où êtes-vous allés ? » Saül a répondu : « Nous sommes allés chercher les ânesses. Comme nous ne les trouvions pas, nous sommes allés voir Samuel. »

sw.L: Na baba mdogo wa Sauli akamwambia yeye na kijana wake, "Mlikwenda wapi?" Naye akasema, "Kuwatafuta punda, na tulipoona kwamba [hawako], tukaja kwa Samweli."
sw.B: Baba mdogo wa Sauli akamwuliza yeye na mtumishi wake, "Mlikuwa wapi?" Sauli akasema, "Tulikuwa tukiwatafuta punda. Tulipoona hawapatikani popote, tukaenda kwa Samweli."
sw.R: Baba mdogo wa Sauli akamwuliza Sauli na mtumishi wake, "Mlikwenda wapi?" Sauli akajibu, "Tulikwenda kuwatafuta punda. Tuliposhindwa kuwapata, tukaenda kumwona Samweli."

vi.L: Chú của Sau-lơ hỏi ông và người đầy tớ: "Các con đã đi đâu?" Ông đáp: "Đi tìm lừa; khi thấy [chúng] không [có], chúng con đến gặp Sa-mu-ên."
vi.B: Chú của Sau-lơ hỏi ông và người đầy tớ: "Các con đã đi đâu vậy?" Sau-lơ đáp: "Đi tìm lừa. Khi thấy không tìm được, chúng con đến gặp Sa-mu-ên."
vi.R: Chú của Sau-lơ hỏi Sau-lơ và người đầy tớ: "Các con đã đi đâu?" Sau-lơ đáp: "Chúng con đi tìm lừa. Khi không tìm thấy, chúng con đến gặp Sa-mu-ên."

decisions.choice: Saul's uncle: his father's brother, perhaps Ner
decisions.reason: The uncle is not named. 14:50-51 names Ner as Abner's father and, by most readings, Kish's brother, so it may be Ner, but the text does not say.

decisions.choice: his young man: the young servant who went with Saul
decisions.reason: The word means a young man and is used of a young servant or attendant, as throughout chapter 9 (9:3, 5, 7-10, 22, 27).

decisions.choice: we saw that they were not: we saw that they were nowhere to be found
decisions.reason: "Not" stands for "not there" or "not to be found"; compare 9:4.

decisions.choice: servant (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "young man" to show the word; Balanced and Readable give his role (m2).

decisions.choice: baba mdogo
decisions.reason: The uncle is his father's brother (m1), "baba mdogo" in Swahili; "mjomba" is a mother's brother.

decisions.choice: "chú" for Saul's uncle; uncle and nephew speak as "chú" and "con"
decisions.reason: The uncle is probably his father's brother (meaning decision), whom Vietnamese calls "chú" (younger) or "bác" (older); "chú" is the more usual guess, and the nephew answers as "con".

source.text: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר דּ֣וֹד שָׁא֑וּל הַגִּֽידָה־נָּ֣א לִ֔י מָֽה־אָמַ֥ר לָכֶ֖ם שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And said [the] uncle of Saul, tell, please, to me what said to you Samuel.

en.L: And Saul's uncle said, "Tell me, please, what Samuel said to you."
en.B: Saul's uncle said, "Please tell me what Samuel said to you."
en.R: His uncle said, "Please tell me what Samuel said to you."

es.L: Y el tío de Saúl dijo: «Cuéntame, te ruego, qué {{plural_you:les|os}} dijo Samuel».
es.B: El tío de Saúl le dijo: «Por favor, cuéntame qué {{plural_you:les|os}} dijo Samuel».
es.R: Su tío le dijo: «Por favor, cuéntame qué {{plural_you:les|os}} dijo Samuel».

fr.L: Et l’oncle de Saül dit : « Raconte-moi donc ce que Samuel vous a dit. »
fr.B: L’oncle de Saül dit : « Raconte-moi, je te prie, ce que Samuel vous a dit. »
fr.R: Son oncle a dit : « S’il te plaît, raconte-moi ce que Samuel vous a dit. »

sw.L: Na baba mdogo wa Sauli akasema, "Tafadhali niambie Samweli aliwaambia nini."
sw.B: Baba mdogo wa Sauli akasema, "Tafadhali niambie Samweli aliwaambia nini."
sw.R: Baba yake mdogo akasema, "Tafadhali niambie Samweli aliwaambia nini."

vi.L: Chú của Sau-lơ nói: "Hãy kể cho chú nghe Sa-mu-ên đã nói gì với các con."
vi.B: Chú của Sau-lơ nói: "Con kể cho chú nghe Sa-mu-ên đã nói gì với các con."
vi.R: Người chú nói: "Con kể cho chú nghe Sa-mu-ên đã nói gì với các con đi."

decisions.choice: to you: both Saul and his servant
decisions.reason: The pronoun is plural; the uncle asks what Samuel told the two of them.

decisions.choice: aliwaambia (plural)
decisions.reason: "To you" includes Saul and his servant (m1); Swahili must choose, and the plural object marker "-wa-" says so.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שָׁאוּל֙ אֶל־דּוֹד֔וֹ הַגֵּ֤ד הִגִּיד֙ לָ֔נוּ כִּ֥י נִמְצְא֖וּ הָאֲתֹנ֑וֹת וְאֶת־דְּבַ֤ר הַמְּלוּכָה֙ לֹֽא־הִגִּ֣יד ל֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֥ר שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And said Saul to his uncle, telling he told us that had been found the donkeys; and [the] matter of the kingship not he told him, which had said Samuel.

en.L: And Saul said to his uncle, "He told us plainly that the donkeys had been found." But the matter of the kingship, which Samuel had spoken, he did not tell him.
en.B: Saul answered his uncle, "He assured us that the donkeys had been found." But he did not tell him what Samuel had said about the kingship.
en.R: Saul told his uncle, "He told us for certain that the donkeys had been found." But Saul did not say anything about what Samuel had told him about becoming king.

es.L: Y Saúl dijo a su tío: «Nos declaró claramente que habían sido halladas las asnas». Pero el asunto del reino, del que Samuel había hablado, no se lo declaró.
es.B: Saúl le respondió a su tío: «Nos aseguró que las burras ya habían aparecido». Pero no le contó lo que Samuel le había dicho acerca del reino.
es.R: Saúl le contestó a su tío: «Nos dijo con seguridad que las burras ya habían aparecido». Pero Saúl no le dijo nada de lo que Samuel le había dicho sobre llegar a ser rey.

fr.L: Et Saül dit à son oncle : « Il nous a bien raconté que les ânesses avaient été retrouvées. » Mais l’affaire de la royauté, dont Samuel avait parlé, il ne la lui raconta pas.
fr.B: Saül répondit à son oncle : « Il nous a assuré que les ânesses avaient été retrouvées. » Mais il ne lui raconta pas ce que Samuel avait dit au sujet de la royauté.
fr.R: Saül a dit à son oncle : « Il nous a dit que les ânesses avaient bien été retrouvées. » Mais Saül n’a rien dit de ce que Samuel lui avait annoncé : qu’il allait devenir roi.

sw.L: Na Sauli akamwambia baba yake mdogo, "Alituambia waziwazi kwamba punda wamepatikana." Lakini habari ya ufalme, ambayo Samweli aliisema, hakumwambia.
sw.B: Sauli akamjibu baba yake mdogo, "Alituhakikishia kwamba punda wamepatikana." Lakini hakumwambia yale Samweli aliyosema kuhusu ufalme.
sw.R: Sauli akamwambia baba yake mdogo, "Alituambia kwa uhakika kwamba punda wamepatikana." Lakini Sauli hakusema lolote kuhusu yale ambayo Samweli alimwambia juu ya kuwa mfalme.

vi.L: Sau-lơ nói với chú mình: "Ông ấy đã cho chúng con biết chắc rằng lừa đã được tìm thấy." Nhưng về việc vương quyền mà Sa-mu-ên đã nói thì ông không kể cho chú nghe.
vi.B: Sau-lơ đáp: "Ông ấy cam đoan với chúng con rằng đàn lừa đã được tìm thấy." Nhưng ông không kể cho chú điều Sa-mu-ên đã nói về vương quyền.
vi.R: Sau-lơ nói với chú: "Ông ấy nói chắc chắn với chúng con rằng đàn lừa đã được tìm thấy." Nhưng Sau-lơ không nói gì về điều Sa-mu-ên đã bảo ông về việc làm vua.

decisions.choice: telling he told us: he told us plainly
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats the verb for emphasis: Samuel said it clearly.

decisions.choice: Saul keeps silent about the kingship
decisions.reason: The text does not say why. It may be modesty (9:21), caution, or the reserve that shows again when he hides (verse 22) and when he says nothing to his critics (verse 27).

decisions.choice: the kingship: the office of king
decisions.reason: The word names the royal office itself, as in verse 25 and 11:14; Samuel had spoken to Saul about it privately (9:20, 27; 10:1).

decisions.choice: about becoming king (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable puts "the matter of the kingship" as what it meant for Saul.
