records.literal_gloss: And called together Samuel the people to Yahweh [at] Mizpah.

en.L: And Samuel called the people together to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at Mizpah.
en.B: Samuel summoned the people to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at Mizpah.
en.R: Samuel called the people to come together at Mizpah to meet with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y Samuel convocó al pueblo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en Mizpa.
es.B: Samuel convocó al pueblo ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en Mizpa.
es.R: Samuel llamó al pueblo a reunirse en Mizpa para presentarse ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et Samuel convoqua le peuple auprès {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Mitspa.
fr.B: Samuel convoqua le peuple devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à Mitspa.
fr.R: Samuel a appelé le peuple à se réunir à Mitspa pour se présenter devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na Samweli akawaita watu wakusanyike kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Mizpa.
sw.B: Samweli akawaita watu wakusanyike mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Mizpa.
sw.R: Samweli aliwaita watu wakusanyike Mizpa ili kukutana na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên triệu tập dân chúng đến cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Mích-ba.
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên triệu tập dân chúng đến trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Mích-ba.
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên kêu gọi dân chúng tập họp tại Mích-ba để gặp {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

decisions.choice: Mizpah: a gathering place in Benjamin
decisions.reason: Mizpah ("lookout") was where Samuel had gathered Israel to pray and where the LORD gave them victory over the Philistines (7:5-12). It was one of the places where he judged Israel (7:16).

decisions.choice: to the LORD: to an assembly held before the LORD
decisions.reason: The people are summoned not only to Samuel but to stand before the LORD, who is to choose the king (verses 19-24).

decisions.choice: to meet with (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says what being called "to the LORD" means (m2).

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗לפכֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אָנֹכִ֛י הֶעֱלֵ֥יתִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וָאַצִּ֤יל אֶתְכֶם֙ מִיַּ֣ד מִצְרַ֔יִם וּמִיַּד֙ כָּל־הַמַּמְלָכ֔וֹת הַלֹּחֲצִ֖ים אֶתְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to [the] sons of Israel, thus says Yahweh, [the] God of Israel, I brought up Israel from Egypt, and I delivered you from [the] hand of Egypt and from [the] hand of all the kingdoms oppressing you.

en.L: And he said to the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, "Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel: 'I brought up Israel from Egypt, and I delivered you from the hand of Egypt and from the hand of all the kingdoms that were oppressing you.'
en.B: He said to the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, says this: 'I brought Israel up out of Egypt. I rescued you from the power of the Egyptians and of all the kingdoms that were oppressing you.'
en.R: He said to the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}, "This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, says: 'I am the one who brought Israel out of Egypt. I saved you from the Egyptians and from all the kingdoms that were treating you cruelly.'

es.L: Y dijo a los hijos de Israel: «Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel: “Yo hice subir a Israel de Egipto, y {{plural_you:los|os}} libré de la mano de Egipto y de la mano de todos los reinos que {{plural_you:los|os}} oprimían”.
es.B: Les dijo a los israelitas: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, dice esto: “Yo saqué a Israel de Egipto. Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} libré del poder de los egipcios y de todos los reinos que {{plural_you:los|os}} oprimían”.
es.R: Les dijo a los israelitas: «Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel: “Yo soy el que sacó a Israel de Egipto. Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} salvé de los egipcios y de todos los reinos que {{plural_you:los|os}} trataban con crueldad”.

fr.L: Et il dit aux {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël : « Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël : “C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui ai fait monter Israël d’Égypte, et je vous ai délivrés de la main de l’Égypte et de la main de tous les royaumes qui vous opprimaient.”
fr.B: Il dit aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} : « Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël : “J’ai fait monter Israël d’Égypte. Je vous ai délivrés du pouvoir des Égyptiens et de tous les royaumes qui vous opprimaient.”
fr.R: Il a dit aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} : « Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël : “C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui ai fait sortir Israël d’Égypte. Je vous ai sauvés des Égyptiens et de tous les royaumes qui vous maltraitaient.”

sw.L: Naye akawaambia wana wa Israeli, "Hivi ndivyo asemavyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli: 'Mimi niliwapandisha Israeli kutoka Misri, nami niliwaokoa ninyi na mkono wa Misri na mkono wa falme zote zilizokuwa zikiwaonea.'
sw.B: Akawaambia Waisraeli, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, asema hivi: 'Niliwapandisha Israeli kutoka Misri. Niliwaokoa ninyi na nguvu za Wamisri na za falme zote zilizokuwa zikiwaonea.'
sw.R: Akawaambia Waisraeli, "Hiki ndicho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, anachosema: 'Mimi ndiye niliyewatoa Israeli Misri. Niliwaokoa ninyi na Wamisri na falme zote zilizokuwa zikiwatendea kwa ukatili.'

vi.L: Người nói với con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này: 'Ta đã đem Y-sơ-ra-ên lên khỏi Ai Cập, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giải cứu các ngươi khỏi tay người Ai Cập và khỏi tay mọi vương quốc đã áp bức các ngươi.'
vi.B: Người nói với dân Y-sơ-ra-ên: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này: 'Ta đã đem Y-sơ-ra-ên lên khỏi Ai Cập. Ta đã giải cứu các ngươi khỏi quyền lực của người Ai Cập và của mọi vương quốc đã áp bức các ngươi.'
vi.R: Người nói với dân Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán: 'Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đem Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi Ai Cập. Ta đã cứu các ngươi khỏi người Ai Cập và khỏi mọi vương quốc đã đối xử tàn ác với các ngươi.'

decisions.choice: I brought up Israel from Egypt and delivered you: the LORD's past rescues
decisions.reason: The words recall the exodus and the time of the judges, when the LORD rescued Israel from every oppressor; a prophet speaks almost the same words in Judges 6:8-9. They set up the charge of verse 19.

decisions.choice: Israel, then you: from the nation to the people standing there
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks of "Israel" in the third person and then turns to "you"; the people at Mizpah are the Israel he rescued.

decisions.choice: the LORD's words end with this verse
alternatives: the LORD's words continue through verse 19
decisions.reason: Verse 19 speaks of "your God" in the third person, so it is read as Samuel's own words drawing the conclusion. It is also possible that the LORD's message runs on into verse 19.

decisions.choice: the power of (Balanced); from (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Hand" stands for power, as in Judges; Balanced says "power" and Readable leaves the picture out.

decisions.choice: I am the one who brought (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts in the pronoun "I" for emphasis; Readable brings that out.

decisions.choice: God speaking to the people through Samuel calls them "các ngươi"
decisions.reason: God rebukes a people who have rejected him (verse 19); the Genesis terms note's plain "ngươi" for God speaking fits a speech of judgment.

source.text: וְאַתֶּ֨ם הַיּ֜וֹם מְאַסְתֶּ֣ם אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר־ה֣וּא מוֹשִׁ֣יעַ לָכֶם֮ מִכָּל־רָעוֹתֵיכֶ֣ם וְצָרֹֽתֵיכֶם֒ וַתֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֔וֹ כִּי־מֶ֖לֶךְ תָּשִׂ֣ים עָלֵ֑ינוּ וְעַתָּ֗ה הִֽתְיַצְּבוּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶ֖ם וּלְאַלְפֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you today have rejected your God, who he [is] saving you from all your calamities and your distresses, and you said to him, but a king you will set over us; and now present yourselves before Yahweh by your tribes and by your thousands.

en.L: But you today have rejected your God, who {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} saves you from all your calamities and your distresses, and you have said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, 'But a king you shall set over us.' And now present yourselves before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} by your tribes and by your thousands."
en.B: But today you have rejected your God, the one who saves you from all your troubles and distress. You have told {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, 'Set a king over us instead.' So now present yourselves before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} tribe by tribe and clan by clan."
en.R: But today you have rejected your God, who rescues you from all your troubles and hard times. You said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, 'Give us a king instead.' So now come and stand before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, tribe by tribe and clan by clan."

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} hoy {{plural_you:han rechazado a su Dios|habéis rechazado a vuestro Dios}}, que es quien {{plural_you:los|os}} salva de todas {{plural_you:sus calamidades|vuestras calamidades}} y {{plural_you:sus angustias|vuestras angustias}}, y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} {{plural_you:han dicho|habéis dicho}}: “Pero un rey pondrás sobre nosotros”. Ahora, pues, {{plural_you:preséntense|presentaos}} delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} por {{plural_you:sus tribus|vuestras tribus}} y por {{plural_you:sus millares|vuestros millares}}».
es.B: Pero hoy {{plural_you:han rechazado a su Dios|habéis rechazado a vuestro Dios}}, el que {{plural_you:los|os}} salva de todos {{plural_you:sus males|vuestros males}} y angustias. Le {{plural_you:han dicho|habéis dicho}}: “Pon más bien un rey sobre nosotros”. Así que ahora {{plural_you:preséntense|presentaos}} delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tribu por tribu y clan por clan».
es.R: Pero hoy {{plural_you:han rechazado a su Dios|habéis rechazado a vuestro Dios}}, que {{plural_you:los|os}} rescata de todos {{plural_you:sus problemas|vuestros problemas}} y dificultades. Le {{plural_you:dijeron|dijisteis}}: “Mejor danos un rey”. Así que ahora {{plural_you:vengan|venid}} y {{plural_you:preséntense|presentaos}} delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, tribu por tribu y clan por clan».

fr.L: Mais vous, aujourd’hui, vous avez rejeté votre Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui vous sauve de tous vos malheurs et de vos détresses, et vous {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avez dit : “Non, c’est un roi que tu établiras sur nous.” Et maintenant, présentez-vous devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} selon vos tribus et selon vos milliers. »
fr.B: Mais aujourd’hui, vous avez rejeté votre Dieu, celui qui vous sauve de tous vos malheurs et de vos détresses. Vous {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avez dit : “Établis plutôt un roi sur nous.” Maintenant donc, présentez-vous devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, tribu par tribu et clan par clan. »
fr.R: Mais aujourd’hui, vous avez rejeté votre Dieu, celui qui vous délivre de tous vos malheurs et de vos moments difficiles. Vous {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avez dit : “Donne-nous plutôt un roi.” Alors maintenant, venez vous présenter devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, tribu par tribu et clan par clan. »

sw.L: Lakini ninyi leo mmemkataa Mungu wenu, ambaye {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} mwenyewe huwaokoa na misiba yenu yote na dhiki zenu, nanyi mmemwambia, 'Bali utuwekee mfalme juu yetu.' Basi sasa jihudhurisheni mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa makabila yenu na kwa maelfu yenu."
sw.B: Lakini leo mmemkataa Mungu wenu, yeye anayewaokoa na taabu na dhiki zenu zote. Mmemwambia, 'Badala yake tuwekee mfalme.' Basi sasa jihudhurisheni mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kabila kwa kabila na ukoo kwa ukoo."
sw.R: Lakini leo mmemkataa Mungu wenu, anayewaokoa na taabu zenu zote na nyakati ngumu. Mlimwambia, 'Badala yake tupe mfalme.' Basi sasa njooni msimame mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kabila kwa kabila na ukoo kwa ukoo."

vi.L: Nhưng hôm nay anh em đã từ bỏ Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, là Đấng chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứu anh em khỏi mọi tai họa và hoạn nạn, và anh em đã nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: 'Nhưng xin lập một vua trên chúng tôi.' Vậy bây giờ hãy trình diện trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} theo từng chi tộc và theo từng nghìn của anh em."
vi.B: Nhưng hôm nay anh em đã từ bỏ Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, là Đấng giải cứu anh em khỏi mọi tai họa và khốn khó. Anh em đã thưa với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: 'Xin lập một vua trên chúng tôi.' Vậy bây giờ hãy trình diện trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} theo từng chi tộc và từng gia tộc."
vi.R: Nhưng hôm nay anh em đã từ bỏ Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, là Đấng giải cứu anh em khỏi mọi rắc rối và cảnh khốn khó. Anh em đã nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: 'Hãy cho chúng tôi một vua.' Vậy bây giờ hãy đến đứng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, theo từng chi tộc và từng gia tộc."

decisions.choice: you have rejected your God
decisions.reason: The LORD had told Samuel that in asking for a king the people had rejected him, not Samuel (8:7; compare 8:19-20). Samuel now says it to the people themselves.

decisions.choice: you said to him, "But a king ...": the Hebrew text
alternatives: you said, "No! Set a king over us"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word for "to him" sounds the same as the word for "no". Some Hebrew manuscripts and ancient translations read "you said, 'No, but set a king over us'", as in 8:19. The meaning is close either way; the main Hebrew text is followed.

decisions.choice: your thousands: your clans
decisions.reason: The word usually means "thousand", but here, set beside "tribes", it names a clan or family division of a tribe, as in Judges 6:15 (compare the note at Numbers 1:21). Verse 21 uses the ordinary word for clan.

decisions.choice: present yourselves before the LORD: stand ready for the LORD's choice
decisions.reason: The people gather by tribe and clan so that the LORD can show his choice by lot, as at Joshua 7:14-18. Verses 20-21 describe it.

decisions.choice: thousands (Literal); clan by clan (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the word; Balanced and Readable give its sense here (m3).

source.text: וַיַּקְרֵ֣ב שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת כָּל־שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּלָּכֵ֖ד שֵׁ֥בֶט בִּנְיָמִֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And brought near Samuel all [the] tribes of Israel, and was taken [the] tribe of Benjamin.

en.L: And Samuel brought near all the tribes of Israel, and the tribe of Benjamin was taken.
en.B: Samuel then brought all the tribes of Israel forward, and the lot fell on the tribe of Benjamin.
en.R: Samuel had all the tribes of Israel come forward one by one. The tribe of Benjamin was chosen.

es.L: E hizo acercarse Samuel a todas las tribus de Israel, y fue tomada la tribu de Benjamín.
es.B: Entonces Samuel hizo que se acercaran todas las tribus de Israel, y la suerte cayó sobre la tribu de Benjamín.
es.R: Samuel hizo pasar al frente una por una a todas las tribus de Israel. La tribu de Benjamín fue la escogida.

fr.L: Et Samuel fit approcher toutes les tribus d’Israël, et la tribu de Benjamin fut désignée.
fr.B: Samuel fit alors approcher toutes les tribus d’Israël, et le sort tomba sur la tribu de Benjamin.
fr.R: Samuel a fait avancer toutes les tribus d’Israël, l’une après l’autre. C’est la tribu de Benjamin qui a été choisie.

sw.L: Na Samweli akawakaribisha makabila yote ya Israeli, na kabila la Benyamini likatwaliwa.
sw.B: Kisha Samweli akayaleta mbele makabila yote ya Israeli, na kura ikaangukia kabila la Benyamini.
sw.R: Samweli aliyafanya makabila yote ya Israeli yaje mbele moja baada ya jingine. Kabila la Benyamini likachaguliwa.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên cho tất cả các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên đến gần, và chi tộc Bên-gia-min được chọn.
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên cho tất cả các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên lần lượt đến gần, và thăm trúng chi tộc Bên-gia-min.
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên cho từng chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên tiến lên. Chi tộc Bên-gia-min được chọn.

decisions.choice: brought near and was taken: the choice made by lot
decisions.reason: "Was taken" is the word used for one picked out by lot, as when Achan was found (Joshua 7:14-18) and when Jonathan was found (14:41-42). Casting the lot left the choice to the LORD (Proverbs 16:33). How it was done here, perhaps with the Urim and Thummim, is not said.

decisions.choice: the lot fell on (Balanced); one by one (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced says how the tribe was "taken"; Readable says that the tribes came forward in turn.

source.text: וַיַּקְרֵ֞ב אֶת־שֵׁ֤בֶט בִּנְיָמִן֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔יו וַתִּלָּכֵ֖ד מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַמַּטְרִ֑י וַיִּלָּכֵד֙ שָׁא֣וּל בֶּן־קִ֔ישׁ וַיְבַקְשֻׁ֖הוּ וְלֹ֥א נִמְצָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: And he brought near [the] tribe of Benjamin by its clans, and was taken [the] clan of the Matrites, and was taken Saul son of Kish; and they sought him, and not he was found.

en.L: And he brought near the tribe of Benjamin by its clans, and the clan of the Matrites was taken, and Saul son of Kish was taken. And they looked for him, and he was not found.
en.B: Then he had the tribe of Benjamin come forward clan by clan, and the clan of the Matrites was chosen. Finally Saul son of Kish was chosen. But when they searched for him, he was not there.
en.R: Then he had the tribe of Benjamin come forward clan by clan, and the Matrite clan was chosen. At last Saul son of Kish was chosen. But when they looked for him, they could not find him.

es.L: E hizo acercarse la tribu de Benjamín por sus clanes, y fue tomado el clan de Matri, y fue tomado Saúl hijo de Cis. Y lo buscaron, y no fue hallado.
es.B: Luego hizo pasar a la tribu de Benjamín clan por clan, y fue escogido el clan de Matri. Por último fue escogido Saúl hijo de Cis. Pero cuando lo buscaron, no estaba allí.
es.R: Luego hizo pasar a la tribu de Benjamín clan por clan, y fue escogido el clan de Matri. Al final fue escogido Saúl hijo de Cis. Pero cuando lo buscaron, no lo pudieron encontrar.

fr.L: Et il fit approcher la tribu de Benjamin selon ses clans, et le clan des Matrites fut désigné, et Saül fils de Kis fut désigné. Et ils le cherchèrent, et il ne fut pas trouvé.
fr.B: Puis il fit approcher la tribu de Benjamin clan par clan, et le clan des Matrites fut désigné. Enfin, Saül fils de Kis fut désigné. Mais quand on le chercha, il était introuvable.
fr.R: Ensuite, il a fait avancer la tribu de Benjamin clan par clan, et c’est le clan de Matri qui a été choisi. Finalement, c’est Saül, le fils de Kis, qui a été choisi. Mais quand on l’a cherché, on ne l’a pas trouvé.

sw.L: Naye akalikaribisha kabila la Benyamini kwa koo zake, na ukoo wa Wamatri ukatwaliwa, na Sauli mwana wa Kishi akatwaliwa. Nao wakamtafuta, lakini hakuonekana.
sw.B: Kisha akalileta mbele kabila la Benyamini ukoo kwa ukoo, na ukoo wa Wamatri ukachaguliwa. Mwishowe Sauli mwana wa Kishi akachaguliwa. Lakini walipomtafuta, hakuwepo.
sw.R: Kisha akalifanya kabila la Benyamini lije mbele ukoo kwa ukoo, na ukoo wa Wamatri ukachaguliwa. Mwishowe Sauli mwana wa Kishi akachaguliwa. Lakini walipomtafuta, hawakumwona.

vi.L: Người cho chi tộc Bên-gia-min đến gần theo từng gia tộc, và gia tộc Mát-ri được chọn; rồi Sau-lơ con trai Kích được chọn. Người ta tìm ông, nhưng không thấy.
vi.B: Rồi người cho chi tộc Bên-gia-min tiến lên theo từng gia tộc, và gia tộc Mát-ri được chọn. Cuối cùng Sau-lơ con trai Kích được chọn. Nhưng khi người ta tìm ông thì ông không có ở đó.
vi.R: Rồi người cho chi tộc Bên-gia-min tiến lên theo từng gia tộc, và gia tộc Mát-ri được chọn. Cuối cùng Sau-lơ con trai Kích được chọn. Nhưng khi người ta đi tìm thì không thấy ông đâu.

decisions.choice: the Matrites, then Saul: the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The Hebrew passes straight from the clan to Saul. The ancient Greek translation adds a step, "and he brought near the clan of Matri man by man", as in Joshua 7:17-18. The meaning is the same; the shorter Hebrew is followed.

decisions.choice: by its clans: the form to be read aloud
decisions.reason: The written text has "by its clan"; the form marked to be read aloud has the plural, "by its clans", which is followed.

decisions.choice: the Matrites: a Benjaminite clan named only here
decisions.reason: The clan is not listed elsewhere among Benjamin's families (compare Numbers 26:38-41; 9:1).

decisions.choice: Finally / At last
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable mark that this is the last step of the choosing.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ־עוֹד֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה הֲבָ֥א ע֖וֹד הֲלֹ֣ם אִ֑ישׁסוַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּה־ה֥וּא נֶחְבָּ֖א אֶל־הַכֵּלִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And they inquired again of Yahweh, has come yet here [the] man? And said Yahweh, look, he [is] hiding himself among the baggage.

en.L: And they inquired again of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "Has the man come here yet?" And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, "Look, he has hidden himself among the baggage."
en.B: So they inquired again of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "Has the man come here yet?" {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} answered, "There he is, hiding among the baggage."
en.R: So they asked {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} again, "Is the man here?" {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} answered, "He is hiding among the bags and supplies."

es.L: Y volvieron a consultar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «¿Ha venido aún acá el hombre?». Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: «He aquí, él se ha escondido entre el equipaje».
es.B: Así que volvieron a consultar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «¿Ha venido ya el hombre?». {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} respondió: «Ahí está, escondido entre el equipaje».
es.R: Entonces volvieron a preguntarle {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «¿Está aquí el hombre?». {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} respondió: «Está escondido entre las bolsas y las provisiones».

fr.L: Et ils consultèrent encore {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : « L’homme est-il encore venu ici ? » Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : « Voici, il s’est caché parmi les bagages. »
fr.B: On consulta donc encore {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : « L’homme est-il déjà venu ici ? » {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} répondit : « Le voici, caché parmi les bagages. »
fr.R: Alors on a de nouveau demandé {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Est-ce que l’homme est ici ? » {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a répondu : « Il se cache au milieu des bagages et des provisions. »

sw.L: Nao wakamwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} tena, "Je, mtu huyo amekwisha kuja hapa?" Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, "Tazama, amejificha kati ya mizigo."
sw.B: Basi wakamwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} tena, "Je, mtu huyo amekwisha kufika hapa?" {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akajibu, "Yule pale, amejificha kati ya mizigo."
sw.R: Basi wakamwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} tena, "Je, mtu huyo yuko hapa?" {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akajibu, "Amejificha kati ya mizigo na vyakula."

vi.L: Họ lại cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Người ấy đã đến đây chưa?" {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Kìa, nó đang trốn giữa đống hành lý."
vi.B: Vậy họ lại cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Người ấy đã đến đây chưa?" {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đáp: "Người ấy đang trốn giữa đống hành lý kia."
vi.R: Vậy họ lại hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Người ấy có ở đây không?" {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đáp: "Người ấy đang trốn giữa đống túi và đồ đạc."

decisions.choice: inquired of the LORD: asked for an answer from God, probably through the priest
decisions.reason: Israel asked the LORD's will through the priest and the ephod or the Urim and Thummim (14:36-42; 23:9-12; 30:7-8). Here the answer is more than yes or no.

decisions.choice: has the man come here yet?: is Saul even at the assembly?
alternatives: Is there yet another man to come here?
decisions.reason: The Hebrew can be read "Has anyone else come here?" or "Has the man come here yet?"; the ancient Greek translation reads "Has the man come here?". The question is whether the one chosen is present at all.

decisions.choice: the baggage: the gear and supplies of those who had come
decisions.reason: The word covers all kinds of equipment and supplies, as in 17:22 and 25:13.

decisions.choice: he has hidden himself: the text does not say why
decisions.reason: It may be modesty (9:21), fear of the task, or reluctance; the text leaves it open.

decisions.choice: There he is, hiding (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Balanced puts "look" into a natural English pointer.

decisions.choice: "consulter le SEIGNEUR"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note settles for asking God for an answer, probably through the priest (m1); Readable says "demander au SEIGNEUR".

decisions.choice: "consultar al SEÑOR" (L, B); "preguntarle al SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel, as the Samuel terms note: "inquire of the LORD" is "consultar al SEÑOR"; Readable uses the everyday verb, as the English Readable says "asked".

decisions.choice: wakamwuliza BWANA
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: "inquire of the LORD" is "kumwuliza BWANA" at every level.

decisions.choice: "cầu hỏi CHÚA" (L, B); "hỏi CHÚA" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for "inquire of the LORD".

source.text: וַיָּרֻ֨צוּ֙ וַיִּקָּחֻ֣הוּ מִשָּׁ֔ם וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֖ב בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעָ֑ם וַיִּגְבַּהּ֙ מִכָּל־הָעָ֔ם מִשִּׁכְמ֖וֹ וָמָֽעְלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they ran and took him from there, and he stood in [the] midst of the people, and he was taller than all the people from his shoulder and upward.

en.L: And they ran and took him from there, and he stood among the people, and he was taller than all the people from his shoulder and upward.
en.B: They ran and brought him out, and when he stood among the people he was taller than any of them by a head and shoulders.
en.R: They ran and brought him out. When he stood among the people, he was so tall that the others came only up to his shoulders.

es.L: Y corrieron y lo tomaron de allí, y se puso en medio del pueblo, y era más alto que todo el pueblo de los hombros arriba.
es.B: Corrieron y lo sacaron de allí, y cuando se puso en medio del pueblo, sobresalía por encima de todos de los hombros para arriba.
es.R: Corrieron y lo sacaron de allí. Cuando se puso en medio de la gente, era tan alto que los demás solo le llegaban a los hombros.

fr.L: Et ils coururent et le prirent de là, et il se tint au milieu du peuple, et il était plus grand que tout le peuple depuis l’épaule et au-dessus.
fr.B: On courut le chercher, et quand il se tint au milieu du peuple, il dépassait tout le monde de la tête et des épaules.
fr.R: Ils ont couru le chercher. Quand il s’est tenu au milieu du peuple, il était si grand que les autres lui arrivaient seulement aux épaules.

sw.L: Nao wakakimbia wakamchukua kutoka huko, naye akasimama kati ya watu, naye alikuwa mrefu kuliko watu wote kutoka mabegani mwake na kwenda juu.
sw.B: Wakakimbia wakamtoa huko, naye aliposimama kati ya watu alikuwa mrefu kuliko wote kwa kimo cha mabega na kichwa.
sw.R: Wakakimbia wakamtoa huko. Aliposimama kati ya watu, alikuwa mrefu sana hata wengine walimfikia mabegani tu.

vi.L: Họ chạy đến đem ông ra khỏi đó; ông đứng giữa dân chúng, và ông cao hơn cả dân chúng từ vai trở lên.
vi.B: Họ chạy đến đưa ông ra. Khi ông đứng giữa dân chúng, ông cao hơn mọi người cả một cái đầu.
vi.R: Họ chạy đến đưa ông ra. Khi ông đứng giữa dân chúng, ông cao đến nỗi những người khác chỉ đứng tới vai ông.

decisions.choice: from his shoulder and upward: head and shoulders taller
decisions.reason: The same words describe Saul in 9:2.

decisions.choice: his height: what people see
decisions.reason: Saul looks like a king. Later, when David is chosen, the LORD tells Samuel not to look at appearance or height (16:7).

decisions.choice: by a head and shoulders (Balanced); the others came only up to his shoulders (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the picture of the idiom in plain English.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל אֶל־כָּל־הָעָ֗ם הַרְּאִיתֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽחַר־בּ֣וֹ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין כָּמֹ֖הוּ בְּכָל־הָעָ֑ם וַיָּרִ֧עוּ כָל־הָעָ֛ם וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ יְחִ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And said Samuel to all the people, do you see whom has chosen him Yahweh? For there is none like him among all the people. And shouted all the people and said, may live the king!

en.L: And Samuel said to all the people, "Do you see the one whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has chosen? For there is none like him among all the people." And all the people shouted and said, "May the king live!"
en.B: Samuel said to all the people, "Do you see the man {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has chosen? Among all the people there is no one like him." Then all the people shouted, "Long live the king!"
en.R: Samuel said to all the people, "Look at the man {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has chosen! There is no one like him among us all." Then all the people shouted, "Long live the king!"

es.L: Y Samuel dijo a todo el pueblo: «¿{{plural_you:Ven|Veis}} al que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha escogido? Porque no hay nadie como él en todo el pueblo». Y todo el pueblo gritó y dijo: «¡Viva el rey!».
es.B: Samuel le dijo a todo el pueblo: «¿{{plural_you:Ven|Veis}} al hombre que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha escogido? No hay nadie como él en todo el pueblo». Entonces todo el pueblo gritó: «¡Viva el rey!».
es.R: Samuel le dijo a todo el pueblo: «¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}} al hombre que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha escogido! No hay nadie como él entre todos nosotros». Entonces todo el pueblo gritó: «¡Viva el rey!».

fr.L: Et Samuel dit à tout le peuple : « Voyez-vous celui que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a choisi ? Car il n’y a personne comme lui dans tout le peuple. » Et tout le peuple poussa des cris et dit : « Que le roi vive ! »
fr.B: Samuel dit à tout le peuple : « Voyez-vous l’homme que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a choisi ? Dans tout le peuple, il n’y a personne comme lui. » Alors tout le peuple s’écria : « Vive le roi ! »
fr.R: Samuel a dit à tout le peuple : « Regardez l’homme que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a choisi ! Il n’y a personne comme lui parmi nous tous. » Alors tout le peuple a crié : « Vive le roi ! »

sw.L: Na Samweli akawaambia watu wote, "Je, mnamwona yule ambaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amemchagua? Kwa maana hakuna aliye kama yeye kati ya watu wote." Na watu wote wakapiga kelele wakasema, "Mfalme na aishi!"
sw.B: Samweli akawaambia watu wote, "Mnamwona mtu ambaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amemchagua? Kati ya watu wote hakuna aliye kama yeye." Ndipo watu wote wakapiga kelele, "Mfalme na aishi maisha marefu!"
sw.R: Samweli akawaambia watu wote, "Mtazameni mtu ambaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amemchagua! Hakuna mtu kama yeye kati yetu sote." Ndipo watu wote wakapiga kelele, "Mfalme na aishi maisha marefu!"

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên nói với toàn dân: "Anh em có thấy người mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn không? Vì trong toàn dân không có ai như người ấy." Toàn dân reo hò và nói: "Nguyện vua sống!"
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên nói với toàn dân: "Anh em có thấy người {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn không? Trong toàn dân không ai bằng người." Bấy giờ toàn dân reo hò: "Vua vạn tuế!"
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên nói với toàn dân: "Hãy nhìn người {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn! Trong tất cả chúng ta không ai bằng người." Bấy giờ toàn dân reo hò: "Vua vạn tuế!"

decisions.choice: the one the LORD has chosen
decisions.reason: The law said that Israel's king must be one whom the LORD chooses (Deuteronomy 17:15). The lot has shown that choice before all the people.

decisions.choice: none like him: no one his equal
decisions.reason: After verse 23 the words point first to his height and bearing, though they may say more.

decisions.choice: may the king live: the shout that hails a new king
decisions.reason: The same cry greets Absalom and Solomon (2 Samuel 16:16; 1 Kings 1:25, 34, 39). It is a wish for the king's long life and a public act of accepting him.

decisions.choice: Long live the king! (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the set English form of the acclamation.

decisions.choice: "Nguyện vua sống!" (L); "Vua vạn tuế!" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The shout that hails a new king (meaning decision): Literal keeps the Hebrew wish, and Balanced and Readable use the Vietnamese acclamation of a king.

source.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל אֶל־הָעָ֗ם אֵ֚ת מִשְׁפַּ֣ט הַמְּלֻכָ֔ה וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב בַּסֵּ֔פֶר וַיַּנַּ֖ח לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיְשַׁלַּ֧ח שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל אֶת־כָּל־הָעָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ לְבֵיתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And spoke Samuel to the people the rule of the kingship, and he wrote [it] in the book and set [it] before Yahweh; and sent away Samuel all the people, each to his house.

en.L: And Samuel spoke to the people the rule of the kingship, and he wrote [it] in the book and set [it] before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. And Samuel sent all the people away, each [one] to his house.
en.B: Samuel explained to the people the rights and duties of the kingship. He wrote them in a scroll and placed it before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Then Samuel sent all the people home.
en.R: Samuel explained to the people the rules for how a king must rule. He wrote them down on a scroll and kept it in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Then Samuel sent everyone home.

es.L: Y Samuel dijo al pueblo el derecho del reino, y [lo] escribió en el libro y [lo] puso delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Y Samuel despidió a todo el pueblo, cada uno a su casa.
es.B: Samuel le explicó al pueblo los derechos y deberes de la monarquía. Los escribió en un rollo y lo depositó delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Luego Samuel mandó a todo el pueblo a sus casas.
es.R: Samuel le explicó al pueblo las reglas sobre cómo debe gobernar un rey. Las escribió en un rollo y lo guardó en la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Después Samuel mandó a todos a sus casas.

fr.L: Et Samuel dit au peuple le droit de la royauté, et il [l’]écrivit dans le livre et [le] déposa devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Et Samuel renvoya tout le peuple, chacun à sa maison.
fr.B: Samuel exposa au peuple les droits et les devoirs de la royauté. Il les mit par écrit dans un rouleau qu’il déposa devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Puis Samuel renvoya tout le peuple chez soi.
fr.R: Samuel a expliqué au peuple les règles qu’un roi doit respecter pour régner. Il les a écrites sur un rouleau et l’a gardé devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ensuite, Samuel a renvoyé tout le monde à la maison.

sw.L: Na Samweli akawaambia watu kanuni ya ufalme, akaiandika katika kitabu akakiweka mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Na Samweli akawaaga watu wote, kila mtu nyumbani kwake.
sw.B: Samweli akawaeleza watu haki na wajibu wa ufalme. Akaziandika katika kitabu akakiweka mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kisha Samweli akawaaga watu wote warudi nyumbani.
sw.R: Samweli akawaeleza watu kanuni za jinsi mfalme anavyopaswa kutawala. Akaziandika katika kitabu akakiweka mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kisha Samweli akawaruhusu watu wote warudi nyumbani.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên nói cho dân chúng luật lệ của vương quyền, chép [vào] sách và đặt [nó] trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Rồi Sa-mu-ên cho toàn dân về, ai về nhà nấy.
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên giải thích cho dân chúng quyền hạn và bổn phận của vương quyền. Người chép những điều ấy vào một cuộn sách và đặt trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Rồi Sa-mu-ên cho toàn dân ai về nhà nấy.
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên giải thích cho dân chúng những quy định về cách một vị vua phải cai trị. Người viết những điều ấy vào một cuộn sách và giữ cuộn sách ấy trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Rồi Sa-mu-ên cho mọi người về nhà.

decisions.choice: the rule of the kingship: what the king may do and what limits bind him
decisions.reason: The word means rule, right or custom. In 8:9-18 Samuel warned the people of "the rule of the king", what a king would take from them. Here the word is joined to "the kingship" and set before the LORD, which suggests an order that also binds the king, like the law of the king in Deuteronomy 17:14-20.

decisions.choice: wrote it in the book and set it before the LORD: kept a written record at the sanctuary
decisions.reason: "The book" is a scroll. Important documents were laid up before the LORD as a lasting witness, as the book of the law was placed beside the ark (Deuteronomy 31:26).

decisions.choice: rights and duties (Balanced); the rules for how a king must rule (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out the two sides of the word here (m1).

source.text: וְגַ֨ם־שָׁא֔וּל הָלַ֥ךְ לְבֵית֖וֹ גִּבְעָ֑תָה וַיֵּלְכ֣וּ עִמּ֔וֹ הַחַ֕יִל אֲשֶׁר־נָגַ֥ע אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּלִבָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And also Saul went to his house to Gibeah, and went with him the valiant [men] whom had touched God in their heart.

en.L: And Saul also went to his house at Gibeah, and with him went the valiant [men] whose hearts God had touched.
en.B: Saul also went home to Gibeah, and with him went men of valor whose hearts God had moved.
en.R: Saul also went home to Gibeah. A group of brave fighting men went with him, because God had moved their hearts to follow him.

es.L: Y también Saúl se fue a su casa en Guibeá, y fueron con él los valientes cuyo corazón Dios había tocado.
es.B: También Saúl se fue a su casa en Guibeá, y lo acompañaron hombres valientes a quienes Dios había movido el corazón.
es.R: Saúl también se fue a su casa en Guibeá. Un grupo de valientes guerreros se fue con él, porque Dios les había movido el corazón para que lo siguieran.

fr.L: Et Saül aussi s’en alla à sa maison, à Guibea, et avec lui allèrent les vaillants dont Dieu avait touché le cœur.
fr.B: Saül aussi rentra chez lui à Guibea, accompagné de vaillants guerriers dont Dieu avait touché le cœur.
fr.R: Saül aussi est rentré chez lui, à Guibea. Un groupe de guerriers courageux l’a accompagné, parce que Dieu leur avait donné le désir de le suivre.

sw.L: Na Sauli naye akaenda nyumbani kwake Gibea, na pamoja naye wakaenda mashujaa ambao Mungu alikuwa ameigusa mioyo yao.
sw.B: Sauli naye akaenda nyumbani Gibea, na pamoja naye wakaenda watu hodari ambao Mungu alikuwa ameigusa mioyo yao.
sw.R: Sauli naye akarudi nyumbani Gibea. Kundi la wapiganaji hodari likaenda pamoja naye, kwa sababu Mungu alikuwa ameigusa mioyo yao wamfuate.

vi.L: Sau-lơ cũng về nhà mình tại Ghi-bê-a, và đi với ông có những [người] dũng sĩ mà Đức Chúa Trời đã cảm động lòng họ.
vi.B: Sau-lơ cũng về nhà tại Ghi-bê-a, và đi theo ông có những dũng sĩ được Đức Chúa Trời cảm động lòng.
vi.R: Sau-lơ cũng về nhà ở Ghi-bê-a. Một nhóm chiến binh can đảm đi theo ông, vì Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến lòng họ muốn theo ông.

decisions.choice: the valiant men: a band of capable fighting men
decisions.reason: The word means strength, ability, or an army. Here it names a group of able men, ready to fight for the new king. The ancient Greek translation reads "sons of strength", with the same sense.

decisions.choice: God had touched their hearts: God had moved them to follow Saul
decisions.reason: Their loyalty is the work of God, as Saul's new heart was (verse 9). They stand in contrast with the men of verse 27.

decisions.choice: Gibeah: Saul's home town
decisions.reason: Gibeah in Benjamin, a few miles north of Jerusalem, becomes Saul's royal town (11:4; 15:34).

decisions.choice: because ... to follow him (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says what being moved by God meant for these men (m2).

source.text: וּבְנֵ֧י בְלִיַּ֣עַל אָמְר֗וּ מַה־יֹּשִׁעֵ֨נוּ֙ זֶ֔ה וַיִּבְזֻ֕הוּ וְלֹֽא־הֵבִ֥יאוּ ל֖וֹ מִנְחָ֑ה וַיְהִ֖י כְּמַחֲרִֽישׁ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And sons of worthlessness said, how will save us this [one]? And they despised him and not they brought to him a gift; and he was like one keeping silent.

en.L: But sons of worthlessness said, "How will this [one] save us?" And they despised him and did not bring him a gift. But he was like one keeping silent.
en.B: But some worthless men said, "How can this fellow save us?" They looked down on him and brought him no gift. But he held his tongue.
en.R: But some troublemakers said, "How can this man save us?" They looked down on Saul and did not bring him any gift. But Saul said nothing.

es.L: Pero unos hijos de perversidad dijeron: «¿Cómo nos va a salvar este?». Y lo despreciaron y no le llevaron regalo. Pero él fue como quien calla.
es.B: Pero algunos hombres perversos dijeron: «¿Cómo nos va a salvar este?». Lo despreciaron y no le llevaron ningún regalo. Pero él se quedó callado.
es.R: Pero algunos alborotadores dijeron: «¿Cómo nos va a salvar este hombre?». Despreciaron a Saúl y no le llevaron ningún regalo. Pero Saúl no dijo nada.

fr.L: Mais des fils de vaurien dirent : « Comment celui-ci nous sauverait-il ? » Et ils le méprisèrent et ne lui apportèrent pas de présent. Mais il fut comme quelqu’un qui se tait.
fr.B: Mais quelques vauriens dirent : « Comment ce garçon-là pourrait-il nous sauver ? » Ils le méprisèrent et ne lui apportèrent aucun présent. Mais il garda le silence.
fr.R: Mais quelques fauteurs de troubles ont dit : « Comment cet homme pourrait-il nous sauver ? » Ils ont méprisé Saül et ne lui ont apporté aucun cadeau. Mais Saül n’a rien dit.

sw.L: Lakini wana wa ubaya wakasema, "Huyu atatuokoaje?" Nao wakamdharau, wala hawakumletea zawadi. Lakini yeye akawa kama mtu aliyenyamaza.
sw.B: Lakini watu fulani wasiofaa kitu wakasema, "Huyu jamaa atatuokoaje?" Wakamdharau, wala hawakumletea zawadi. Lakini yeye akanyamaza kimya.
sw.R: Lakini watu fulani wakorofi wakasema, "Mtu huyu atatuokoaje?" Wakamdharau Sauli, wala hawakumletea zawadi yoyote. Lakini Sauli hakusema neno.

vi.L: Nhưng những đứa con của sự gian tà nói: "Người này làm sao cứu chúng ta được?" Họ khinh dể ông và không đem lễ vật đến cho ông. Nhưng ông làm như người im lặng.
vi.B: Nhưng có mấy kẻ vô lại nói: "Gã này mà cứu được chúng ta sao?" Họ khinh dể ông và không dâng lễ vật cho ông. Nhưng ông vẫn làm thinh.
vi.R: Nhưng có mấy kẻ gây rối nói: "Người này làm sao cứu chúng ta được?" Họ coi thường Sau-lơ và không đem quà gì đến cho ông. Nhưng Sau-lơ không nói gì.

decisions.choice: sons of worthlessness: worthless, wicked men
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of Eli's sons (2:12) and of the men of Gibeah (Judges 19:22): people who reject what is right. "Sons of" here means men of that kind.

decisions.choice: did not bring him a gift: refused him the tribute owed to a king
decisions.reason: Bringing a gift to a king was a sign of loyalty (2 Samuel 8:2; 1 Kings 10:25). Holding it back was open refusal to accept him.

decisions.choice: How will this one save us?
decisions.reason: The word "save" picks up verse 19: the people rejected the God who saves them and asked for a king. Chapter 11 answers the doubters when Saul does save Israel, and 11:12-13 returns to these men.

decisions.choice: he was like one keeping silent: the Hebrew text
alternatives: the Qumran paragraph about Nahash, read before 11:1
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation and a Hebrew scroll from Qumran read, with nearly the same letters, "and about a month later", which begins the story of 11:1. The Qumran scroll also has a paragraph not found in the other texts: Nahash king of the Ammonites had been harshly oppressing the tribes of Gad and Reuben, gouging out the right eye of each man, and about seven thousand men had escaped to Jabesh-gilead. That would explain why Nahash attacks Jabesh in chapter 11. The traditional Hebrew text is followed here; whether the Qumran paragraph is original or a later addition is debated. This description comes from general knowledge of the scrolls and the Greek manuscripts and must be checked against an edition before review.

decisions.choice: worthless men, held his tongue (Balanced); troublemakers, said nothing (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the phrases in common English.
